We’re seeking an experienced partner payments operator to manage monthly partner payments for one of our clients, a global tech and media company, supporting its streaming TV business. This is a contract role working with the client’s team.

As an independent vendor, you’ll set the rhythm and own the details. The role suits someone who enjoys making sense of complex agreements, tracking down why numbers don’t match, and building systems that make each month easier than the last.

What you’ll own

  • The monthly close: Calculate what each partner is owed, validate the results, and deliver payment files on time every cycle.
  • Contract-to-calculation logic: Read partner agreements and build the models and rules that turn their terms into accurate payouts.
  • Issue resolution: When something is off, find the source and fix it so it doesn’t come back.
  • Process improvement: Replace manual, error-prone steps with automated workflows.
  • Documentation: Maintain a clear playbook so the process is transparent, auditable, and easy to transfer.
  • Cross-team inputs: Work directly with finance, partnerships, and legal to get what you need.

What success looks like

  • Payments go out accurately and on schedule, month after month
  • Each discrepancy is logged with its cause and fix
  • The playbook stays current and someone new could follow it
  • Manual effort drops measurably over the course of the engagement

How you’ll work

You’ll run the process on your own and check in regularly with the business lead to review progress and resolve open questions (cadence to be agreed). You’ll bring in the client only for decisions that require its approval, such as releasing payments or interpreting ambiguous contract language.

Who we’re looking for

Minimum qualifications

  • Background in partner payments, revenue share, royalty operations, deal desk, or finance operations
  • Ability to read commercial contracts closely and translate their terms into financial logic
  • Advanced SQL and spreadsheet skills
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working within financial controls

jobs.title: NIS2 IT System Engineer voor Asset Management en Platformsecurity (Freelance mog
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden De Europese NIS2-richtlijn (Network and Information Security Directive 2) heeft als doel de cyberweerbaarheid van vitale en essentiële organisaties binnen de EU aanzienlijk te verhogen.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

De Europese NIS2-richtlijn (Network and Information Security Directive 2) heeft als doel de cyberweerbaarheid van vitale en essentiële organisaties binnen de EU aanzienlijk te verhogen. De richtlijn verplicht lidstaten en organisaties om technische en organisatorische maatregelen te nemen die de continuïteit en veiligheid van essentiële diensten en digitale infrastructuren waarborgen.

De verplichtingen hebben onder meer betrekking op:

  • Beleid en governance: duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden, toezicht en rapportering over cyberweerbaarheid.
  • Risicobeheer: een structurele aanpak van risico’s op het gebied van informatie- en netwerkbeveiliging.
  • Beveiligingsmaatregelen: technische en organisatorische controls volgens de stand van de techniek.
  • Incidentbeheer en meldplicht: detectie, rapportering en opvolging van beveiligingsincidenten.
  • Leveranciersbeheer: beheersing van risico’s in de keten en toelevering.
  • Continuïteit en herstel: weerbaarheid tegen verstoringen, met inbegrip van business continuity en disaster recovery.

Binnen de betrokken overheidsorganisatie loopt een meerfasig programma om de organisatie structureel volgens de NIS2-vereisten in te richten. Naast technische maatregelen vraagt dit programma ook organisatorische inbedding, governance, risicobewustzijn en change management. De projecten zijn gebaseerd op het CyFun-framework van het CCB.

In de realisatiefase worden de geïdentificeerde maatregelen geïmplementeerd in projecten per CyFun-functie. Voor twee prioritaire projecten is extra ondersteuning nodig:

  • NIS2 Asset Management, CyFun-functie IDENTIFY [ID.AM]. De focus ligt op de identificatie en het beheer van systemen, mensen, assets, data en processen als basis voor risicogebaseerde cybersecuritybeslissingen.
  • NIS2 Data & Platform Security, CyFun-functies PROTECT [PR.DS en PR.PS]. De focus ligt op de bescherming van data en platformen via gegevensbeveiliging, veilige configuratie, softwarebeheer en technische beveiligingsmaatregelen.

2. Opdracht

Als IT System Engineer ondersteun je de uitvoering van de projecten NIS2 Asset Management en NIS2 Data & Platform Security. Je werkt samen met interne teams en externe leveranciers, met bijzondere aandacht voor de inventarisatie van besturingssystemen en software.

1.1 Hoofdtaken en verwachte deliverables: Asset Management (CyFun ID.AM)

De CMDB en inventarissen uitbouwen en actualiseren

Je vergelijkt inventarisgegevens over besturingssystemen en software uit verschillende bronnen met de gegevens in de CMDB. Je spoort ontbrekende, dubbele en verouderde gegevens op, verifieert afwijkingen met de betrokken teams en vult CMDB-records aan of corrigeert ze. Samen met de interne teams werk je het CMDB-gegevensmodel bij waar nodig.

Verwachte deliverables: een bijgewerkte CMDB en actuele inventarissen van besturingssystemen en software, aangevuld met een overzicht van gecorrigeerde en nog openstaande afwijkingen en een bijgewerkt gegevensmodel.

Bestaande documentatie van operationele processen aanvullen en actualiseren

Je toetst de bestaande procesbeschrijvingen voor assetbeheer aan de praktijk. Ontbrekende informatie vul je aan en verouderde onderdelen werk je bij. Je legt vast wie de CMDB en inventarissen onderhoudt, wanneer dit gebeurt en hoe de volledigheid en juistheid worden gecontroleerd.

Verwachte deliverables: geactualiseerde procesbeschrijvingen met duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden voor het beheer en onderhoud van de CMDB en inventarissen.

De uitwisseling van assetgegevens met externe leveranciers technisch ondersteunen

Je stemt met externe leveranciers af welke gegevens beschikbaar en nodig zijn. Je vraagt gegevens op en maakt afspraken over het formaat en de frequentie van aanlevering. Samen met de interne teams controleer en verwerk je de ontvangen gegevens in de CMDB en inventarissen.

Verwachte deliverables: gevalideerde en verwerkte leveranciersgegevens en gedocumenteerde afspraken over de aanlevering en actualisatie ervan.

1.2 Hoofdtaken en verwachte deliverables: Data & Platform Security (CyFun PR.DS en PR.PS)

De huidige situatie documenteren en analyseren en technische maatregelen uitwerken en mee implementeren

Je documenteert en analyseert eerst de huidige situatie (AS-IS). Je actualiseert de inventarissen van gegevens, systemen en platformen en beschrijft de bestaande beveiligingsmaatregelen en operationele processen. Vervolgens stel je samen met de betrokken teams de technische tekortkomingen ten opzichte van de toepasselijke NIS2-vereisten vast, beschrijf je de gewenste situatie (TO-BE) en werk je een technisch implementatievoorstel uit. Je werkt mee aan de implementatie en technische validatie van de afgesproken maatregelen.

Verwachte deliverables: een AS-IS-analyse met bijgewerkte inventarissen en procesbeschrijvingen, een overzicht van de technische tekortkomingen, een beschrijving van de gewenste situatie, een technisch implementatievoorstel en documentatie van de uitgevoerde maatregelen en testresultaten.

3. Samenwerking & positionering

De NIS2 IT System Engineer werkt nauw samen met verschillende verantwoordelijken en teams:

  • Programmaverantwoordelijke NIS2: rapportering, prioritering en afstemming binnen het programma.
  • Businessverantwoordelijke of NIS2-expert: rechtstreekse ondersteuning en inhoudelijke sturing van de projecten.
  • Verantwoordelijke voor de serverinfrastructuur: technische afstemming, prioritering en coördinatie van werkzaamheden op de serverinfrastructuur.
  • Securityverantwoordelijken: technische input en validatie van maatregelen.

4. Vereiste kennis & ervaring (verplicht)

  • Bachelor- of masterdiploma in informatica, bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde, of gelijkwaardig door relevante ervaring.
  • Minimaal 6 jaar ervaring met asset management-tools of CMDB-concepten.
  • Praktische ervaring met het modelleren, beheren en valideren van inventarisgegevens voor besturingssystemen en software.
  • Ervaring met het aanvullen en actualiseren van operationele procesdocumentatie en SOP’s voor IT-assetbeheer. Je kunt technische processen en werkinstructies helder beschrijven.
  • Ervaring met technische afstemming en gegevensuitwisseling met externe leveranciers.
  • Ervaring met het documenteren van controles en het verzamelen van bewijsstukken voor audits.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, analytisch, nauwkeurig, samenwerkingsgericht, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht.

Technische kennis

Linux, PHP, SQL en Windows zijn voor deze functie vereiste kennis op expertniveau.

  • Windows
  • Red Hat en Oracle Linux
  • Windows Application Server en Apache
  • Oracle DB, SQL Server en PostgreSQL
  • .NET, PHP, PowerShell en Linux-scripting

Troeven

  • Ervaring binnen een federale overheidsdienst of een vergelijkbare publieke organisatie.
  • Ervaring met NIS2-implementatietrajecten of eerdere betrokkenheid bij cybersecurityprogramma’s.
  • Kennis van het CyFun-framework en/of gerelateerde frameworks zoals ISO 27001, NIST CSF en CIS Controls.
  • Kennis van AD en GPO.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je hebt ervaring als IT System Engineer en combineert minstens 6 jaar ervaring met asset management of CMDB-concepten met een expert niveau in Linux, PHP, SQL en Windows. Je werkt zelfstandig en nauwkeurig, kunt technische processen helder documenteren en stemt vlot af met interne teams en externe leveranciers.

Je spreekt en schrijft Nederlands en Frans.

  • Linux
  • PHP
  • SQL
  • Windows

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.description:
Junior Full Stack Engineer (Independent Contractor)

Location | Latin America — Remote
Engagement Type | Independent contractor (services agreement)
Availability | General overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

About LoanBud

LoanBud is a fast-growing fintech platform dedicated to SBA financing, connecting entrepreneurs to a nationwide network of lenders and helping small business owners access capital through a streamlined, technology-driven process. We pride ourselves on a collaborative culture, meaningful work, and a strong commitment to supporting the backbone of the economy — small businesses.

Engagement Overview

LoanBud is seeking a junior independent contractor to help build, maintain, and support our proprietary lending and workflow platform. The platform is used by borrowers, loan officers, processors, underwriters, referral partners, lenders, and internal teams.

This is a hands-on engagement for an early-career engineer who wants to grow inside a real production application. You will work mainly in our Java and Spring Boot backend, with contributions to TypeScript front-end work, database changes, and integrations, under the guidance of senior engineers.

Great communication is central to this role. Alongside engineering work, you will support platform users by phone — walking borrowers, loan officers, and partners through issues, gathering clear details about problems, and explaining solutions in plain, friendly language. We are looking for someone who enjoys helping people as much as writing code.

Scope of Services

With support and code review from senior engineers, the contractor will help with:

  • User support by phone — take calls from borrowers, loan officers, processors and partners; troubleshoot their issues live; document what you learn; and follow up until the issue is resolved.
  • Backend — implement and maintain APIs, business logic and integrations in Java 21 / Spring Boot; learn to update underwriting and business rules in Drools.
  • Front end — build and improve TypeScript front-end features and fix UI bugs.
  • Data — write PostgreSQL queries and simple migrations (Spring Data JPA, Liquibase).
  • Integrations — help connect internal and external services via REST APIs and webhooks; keep OpenAPI specs up to date.
  • Async & workflow — monitor background jobs and scheduled processes (JobRunR) and help investigate failed jobs.
  • Platform features — contribute to document storage (S3), email and PDF generation, and SMS (Twilio) features.
  • Reliability — investigate and fix bugs reported by users, turning support calls into clear, reproducible tickets.
  • Delivery — write clean, tested, documented code; take part in code reviews and releases; and share progress, questions and blockers early.

Required Experience
  • 1–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent through internships, bootcamps or substantial personal projects.
  • Excellent communication skills, including confidence supporting users over the phone — patient, clear and friendly with non-technical people, and able to explain technical issues in simple terms.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Working knowledge of Java (Spring Boot exposure is a plus).
  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • Some experience with TypeScript or JavaScript front-end development.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs and how authentication works.
  • Comfort with Git and an interest in automated testing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Eagerness to learn, accept feedback, and grow within an existing codebase.
  • Reliability and accountability: you follow through on what you commit to and keep your team informed.

Nice to Have
  • Previous experience in customer support, help desk, technical support or any client-facing role.
  • Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Liquibase or Lombok.
  • Exposure to background job frameworks (JobRunR or similar) or rules engines (Drools or similar).
  • AWS basics (S3), Docker or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Twilio, PDF generation or email templating (Thymeleaf).
  • Interest in fintech, lending or regulated industries.
  • Spanish or Portuguese in addition to English.
  • A GitHub profile or portfolio showing projects you've built.

Working Arrangement

This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor sets their own schedule, methods and location, and provides their own equipment, workspace, reliable internet and a quiet setting suitable for phone calls with users.

The contractor should generally be reachable during a window overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This is when users call for support and when planning, code reviews and team discussions happen; it is not a mandated schedule or minimum-hours requirement.

Engagement Terms

This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, social contributions, insurance and any registrations required in their jurisdiction, and is not entitled to employee benefits.

Service fees will be based on experience, technical ability and communication skills. Fee structure, invoicing, engagement term and other commercial terms will be discussed during the selection process. The contractor is free to provide services to other clients; exclusivity is not required.

Selection Process

Interested providers should submit a current résumé, along with any work samples or links (GitHub, portfolio) where available.

  1. Initial HR conversation, including an assessment of spoken English and communication style.
  2. Short practical technical exercise.
  3. Support role-play: a simulated phone call with a user reporting a platform issue.
  4. Conversation with our technical leadership.
  5. Final conversation on culture, scope and terms.

We'll share details on each step as you move through the process.

Be Part of Our Growth Story

LoanBud is building a better way for entrepreneurs to access capital, and technology is central to that effort. This engagement is a chance to grow your engineering career on a real fintech platform while directly helping the people who use it — borrowers, partners and lenders.

We're looking for someone who communicates clearly, cares about users, and is eager to learn and follow through. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to gain access to capital.

About Sharesource:

We are a BCorp company whose purpose is to democratise opportunities for individuals from developing countries. With our brand and culture empowering our partners to attract and keep the most qualified members, we share the knowledge to unleash potential and grow scaling teams for Australian and Canadian businesses.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Junior Civil Drafting Engineer to support the production of post-design packages, including right-of-way permit and construction packages, using AutoCAD and AI-assisted tools. Working under the guidance of the Civil Works Manager and senior drafting staff, you will collaborate closely with the Permitting, Project Management, and Design teams to prepare accurate, compliant drawings that capture project specifications such as roads, utilities, and other civil works.

This is a development role ideal for an early-career drafter looking to build strong technical skills in the telecommunications infrastructure industry.

What are you expected to do?

  • Drafting
    • Complete assigned AutoCAD drafting tasks for active civil projects in line with project priorities and deadlines.
    • Manage your own workload, communicate progress on assigned tasks, and raise any risks to deadlines early.
    • Learn and apply client's AutoCAD standards, tools, and best practices, building towards independent production work.
    • Prepare drawings and plan sets from redlines, markups, and design inputs under the direction of senior team members.
    • Interpret survey data and engineering specifications into construction drawings, with guidance and review from senior team members.
    • Update and revise drawings and permit packages in response to agency, client, or internal review comments.
    • Raise drafting and design questions with project managers, engineers, and the Civil Works Manager to clarify scope.
  • Quality and Standards Compliance
    • Apply internal CAD templates, standards, and best practices to all deliverables, following guidance provided by the Civil Works Manager.
    • Check drawings against applicable safety standards, environmental codes, and jurisdictional permitting requirements, with final compliance review by senior team members.
    • Self-review work for accuracy and completeness before submitting for QC, flagging any discrepancies or uncertainties to senior team members.
    • Incorporate redlines and QC feedback promptly, using them to build your knowledge of standards and drafting practices.
  • Technical Analysis and Design Support
    • Assist with reviewing survey data, site conditions, and regulatory constraints to support accurate and compliant drawings.
    • Calculate material quantities and perform basic calculations to support construction package accuracy, with work checked by senior team members.
    • Build a working knowledge of local regulations, jurisdictional requirements, and industry drafting practices relevant to telecom and civil projects.
  • Travel
    • Travel occasionally to project sites or client locations as required, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 5–10% of working time.


You'll be a great fit if:

  • You have working proficiency in AutoCAD and an interest in AI-assisted drafting tools. You have an eagerness to learn and adopt new technologies, which is essential in our fast-moving environment.
  • You have strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality, with the ability to produce accurate, consistent, and thoroughly checked deliverables.
  • You have good organisational and time management skills, with the ability to work across several assignments at once, prioritise with support from your manager, and meet agreed deadlines.
  • You have a collaborative mindset and clear communication skills. You can interact regularly with the Civil Works Manager, Project Managers, and network designers, and have the confidence to ask questions and receive feedback constructively.
  • You have a passion for innovation and a curious mindset. You are willing to learn and develop new skills, industry knowledge, and keep up with technological developments in a constantly evolving industry.
  • You have basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for project tracking, quantity take-offs, and documentation purposes.


Required Education and Experience:

  • You have a bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • You have 1–3 years of CAD drafting experience, preferably in AutoCAD.
  • You have experience in the telecommunications industry, preferably with exposure to OSP design or construction.
  • You have the ability to read and interpret technical drawings, survey plans, and engineering specifications.


What you gain beyond the role:

  • Remote + Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—collaborative office days when it counts, balanced with the freedom to work from home.
  • Achieve Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Work in an environment where you're trusted and empowered to work independently, while still having the support you need to deliver your best. Here, flexibility isn't just a perk—it's how we help you perform at your best, without sacrificing life outside of work.
  • Open Culture: Your voice matters, we encourage proactive communication and fresh ideas.
  • Supportive Team: From your very first day to every career milestone, we've got your back—with long-term growth and projects you can truly thrive in.
  • Learn and Grow: Training, coaching, and international opportunities to level up your skills and career
  • Be part of a B-Corp company that puts people and planet first while creating meaningful impact.

Please note: This role is remote; however, we require candidates to be based locally in the Philippines. This is to support occasional onsite activities such as team events, client meetings, or equipment handover. Additionally, local residency is necessary for compliance with Philippines labor laws and employment regulations.

Why work for Sharesource?

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire hundreds of skillful individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, genders, ages, and personalities to live out our diverse culture and make a positive impact on the world!

Our 5 Values:

  • Make a social impact: We balance our work for client teams and for society by constantly making a positive impact.
  • Be proactive: We encourage brave thinking and continuous improvement, and drive change through action.
  • Create value: We create measurable values for our stakeholders: our teams, partners, suppliers, investors, and communities.
  • Be fair, open and honest: We foster equality and inclusivity in a supportive environment that embraces diversity and celebrates achievements.
  • Add fun, passion and love: We prioritise fun and passion, fostering higher engagement and a positive can-do attitude.

What to Expect in the Process?

  1. You'll go through 3–4 interviews plus a possible assessment with our client partner. This includes an initial chat, a culture-fit interview, and 1–2 conversations with our awesome client. The whole process usually takes 1–2 weeks, but we'll let you know if things need to move quicker.
  2. Our best advice? Be yourself and enjoy the conversations. We'll keep you updated every step of the way, and you're always welcome to reach out for updates anytime.
  3. If all goes well, we'll complete reference checks and requirements quickly—so we can get that job offer to you without delay.

We would be grateful if you have these already:

  • Fit to Work/Health Card (Basic 5 employment medical tests)

  • NBI Clearance

  • Character references with contact info

Cashiering function ensures proper application of all incoming payments through the various payment options established by the company. This will include Payoffs, ACH payments, wires, lockbox payments, online payments, and manually posted payments. This position leads and mentors staff to work effectively and follow credit reporting operational and regulatory compliance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Analyze team results and provide reporting to senior management including aging, volumes, performance trending, and any issues that affect current or future production trending data.
  • Ensures proper application of all incoming payments through the various payment options established by the company. This includes both performing and default payments.

  • Establishes procedures for cash and ensures the proper controls are in place
  • Reports to government agencies as required.
  • Keeps informed on government regulations pertaining to loan servicing
  • Manages all aspects of the in-house lockbox operations through the cashiering department
  • Ensures all borrower funds are disbursed accordingly following payoff or loan removal

  • Perform all actions in accordance with the policies and procedures of the company.
  • Have knowledge about Evergreen’s mortgage processes and products in order to answer questions and support staff.

Specific Skills/ Knowledge/ Abilities Required for Position:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in cash posting in loan servicing for mortgage banking, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 1 - 3 years of management experience
  • Experience with Black Knight/MSP Loan Servicing Software a plus
  • Knowledge of state and federal laws and regulations applicable to mortgage and consumer lending with considerable knowledge of loan servicing practices
  • Analytical ability sufficient to apply data and information to the solution of administrative and operating problems
  • Considerable knowledge of workflow processes, staffing needs, and operational costs in a collection operation
  • Leadership and management skills with the ability to motivate, mentor, train, coach, evaluate performance, and lead a multi-functional staff in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction and to meet deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to read, interpret, and analyze accounts and records of a complex, detailed and recurring nature
  • Analytical ability sufficient to apply data and information to the solution of administrative and operating problems
  • Ability to prepare an operating budget, anticipate and explain variances
  • Ability to work collaboratively with peers, company managers, and customers in a team environment to attain common goals
  • Analytical and mathematical ability sufficient to calculate and evaluate performance metrics and apply them to increased efficiencies and the solution of administrative and operating barriers
  • Ability to communicate effectively both in writing and orally, in person and by telephone, with all levels of the organization and with external customers. Strong instructing and advising skills. Demonstrated ability to provide excellent customer service
  • Ability to enter and extract data from a computer database. Ability to locate data in a computer database for the purpose of researching and resolving customer inquiries
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
  • Considerable knowledge of and ability to use automated accounting systems; ability to use personal computers, peripherals, business software, and applications specific to organizational needs

Title: Sales Development Representative

Function: Sales

Location: Australia - Remote

Position Summary:

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be responsible for developing demand for the company's products and solutions. In this role, you will establish relationships with prospective customers to create a viable sales pipeline through marketing lead generation campaigns and direct outreach. You will play an integral part in conveying the value of the platform to potential clients, directly impacting the company's future success. Additionally, this role offers opportunities for growth and professional development both within and beyond the department.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead Qualification: Identify, engage, and qualify leads from various marketing channels (e.g., website, conferences, etc.) and ensure they align with the company’s solutions.

  • Conduct direct outreach to engage new leads while prospecting into a technical audience, applying a deep understanding of the B2B sales cycle, and effectively handling objections.
  • Analyze lead generation trends and optimize outreach efforts based on feedback and performance metrics.
  • Utilize phone, email, and social selling techniques to connect with key decision-makers, delivering compelling value propositions tailored to their needs.

Sales & Marketing Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between marketing and sales, actively engaging in marketing campaigns, analyzing trends, and collaborating with Account Executives to nurture key prospects and facilitate a seamless transition from prospecting to closing.

Quota Achievement: Engage new leads through direct outreach while developing a broader understanding of the B2B sales cycle, including prospecting into a technical audience and handling objections. Required to consistently meet or exceed assigned quotas for Booked Meetings and Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) contributing to overall revenue growth.

Pipeline & Performance Tracking: Consistently track and report key sales development metrics, including conversion rates, meeting attendance, and engagement trends.

Tools & Technology Usage: Use a variety of sales tools (SalesForce, etc.) to maintain and record detailed and accurate records of customer interactions and pipeline.

Gain experience in a fast-paced culture with corporate exposure while contributing to marketing strategies and developing professionally. Proactively seeks knowledge and stays informed about industry trends and innovations.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Representative
jobs.excerpt: Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
jobs.description:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.

Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining high-quality services consistently.

We achieve the mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the basis of our business philosophy!

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Weekend Customer Operations Representative to support daily shipment coordination, customer communication, and operational execution across domestic and international freight movements.

This role sits at the center of customer operations. You will be responsible for ensuring shipments are accurately built in the TMS, proactively monitored, clearly communicated, and fully updated from pickup through final delivery.

Success in this role comes from consistency, urgency, communication discipline, and operational ownership.

This is not a passive support role. The right person proactively follows up, identifies risks before escalation, communicates clearly with customers and brokers, and keeps freight moving without gaps in visibility.

Role in one line

A logistics operations professional responsible for shipment building, tracking coordination, proactive customer updates, and operational communication across domestic and international freight movements.

What you will do:

Load Building & Shipment Setup

  • Review incoming Delivery Orders (DOs) and identify shipment requirements

  • Build and enter shipments accurately into the TMS

  • Confirm shipment setup completion via email:

    • Reply “received, thank you”

    • Add PO#, BKG#, or MBOL# into the email subject line as required

    • CC tracking teams and operational stakeholders appropriately

  • Ensure shipment data accuracy before operational execution begins

Load Coverage & Shipment Monitoring

  • Confirm all shipments are fully covered prior to scheduled pickup times

  • Escalate uncovered shipments to brokers at least 2 hours before pickup time

  • Monitor shipment progress and communicate operational delays proactively

  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding:

    • Recovery trucks

    • Carrier replacement

    • Service interruptions

    • Late pickups or deliveries

Customer Communication & Updates

Provide proactive shipment visibility and operational updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.

Daily Customer Updates

  • Send daily ETA updates to customers for pickup and delivery appointments

  • Include truck location details when shipments are already loaded

    • Example:

      • “Truck is currently in Houston, TX with ETA to delivery at 09:00 AM”

Pickup & Delivery Notifications

  • Notify customers immediately upon:

    • Driver arrival at shipper

    • Driver arrival at receiver

    • Driver departure from shipper

    • Driver departure from receiver

  • Include exact arrival and departure times in updates

Detention & Delay Communication

  • Notify customers when detention begins for OTR shipments (after 2 hours onsite)

  • Alert brokers immediately regarding:

    • Late pickups

    • Late deliveries

    • Missed appointments

    • Service risks

  • Assist with determining next operational steps:

    • Customer communication

    • Carrier replacement

    • Recovery truck coordination

Import & Export Shipment Coordination

  • Maintain and update shipment tracking charts for import and export freight

  • Update customer tracking sheets with:

    • Appointments

    • Container pull status

    • Container numbers

    • Holds or customs-related issues

    • Delivery updates

  • Monitor and communicate:

    • Container loading schedules

    • Delivery schedules

    • Port or terminal delays

    • Operational exceptions

  • Send final delivery documentation, charges, and PODs upon shipment completion

Requirements

  1. Previous logistics, freight operations, customer operations, dispatch, or transportation coordination experience preferred

  2. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously

  3. Excellent organizational and follow-up skills

  4. Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  5. Ability to provide clear, professional customer updates throughout the day

  6. Comfortable working in fast-paced transportation and logistics environments

  7. Ability to identify operational issues proactively and escalate appropriately

  8. Experience working with TMS systems and shipment tracking tools preferred

  9. Strong sense of urgency and accountability

  10. Ability to work independently in a remote environment

The strongest Customer Operations Representatives:

  • Stay ahead of problems before customers ask questions

  • Communicate proactively rather than reactively

  • Maintain extremely high attention to shipment details

  • Keep customers consistently informed without being prompted

  • Escalate issues early and clearly

  • Remain calm during high-volume operational situations

  • Understand that responsiveness and visibility directly impact customer trust

  • Treat every shipment as time-sensitive and customer-critical

Working conditions:

  • Work schedule: Thursday–Monday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST.

  • A supportive team

  • Competitive Salary in USD

  • Remote eligibility

  • 10+ business days of paid time off

  • Equipment provided

Join our team and become an integral part of our mission to provide reliable and efficient freight transportation solutions to our customers.

jobs.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

We are looking for a Lead Cloud Engineer to design secure, scalable and cost-efficient cloud platforms, on Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and AWS. You will lead architecture on client engagements, guide engineering teams through delivery, and act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders. You will architect automation-first solutions across Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and AWS, lead engagements from presales to delivery, and set the engineering practices our teams build with.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

  • Lead presales: technical discovery, solution design, estimates, proposals and SOWs, demos and proofs of concept.
  • Practice spec-driven development: turn requirements into clear specifications and acceptance criteria, then generate, test and iterate code against them.
  • Lead agent-assisted development: use AI coding agents to produce IaC, pipelines and migrations, with human review, automated tests and security guardrails.
  • Deliver everything through GitOps: no manual or console changes; every change is versioned, reviewed and deployed by pipeline.
  • Build reusable, versioned modules, templates and golden paths that teams and clients can consume and extend.
  • Expose automation through APIs and MCP servers so platforms can be driven by pipelines, tools and AI agents.
  • Codify landing zones, networking, identity and zero-trust security, aligned to the Well-Architected Framework.
  • Codify migrations and disaster recovery so any environment can be rebuilt on demand.
  • Embed policy-as-code, supply chain security, observability and FinOps into the delivery pipeline.
  • Architect AI/ML and GenAI platforms, including RAG and agentic AI workloads.
  • Mentor engineers and maintain the practice's standards, reference architectures and code libraries.

What we need from you:

  • 10+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, with 5+ years in an architect role.
  • Consulting or client-facing delivery experience.
  • Architecture experience across Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and AWS.
  • Automation-first mindset, with a track record of replacing manual and click-ops work with code.
  • Expert Terraform, and strong coding in Python or Go.
  • GitOps and CI/CD: Git workflows, pull-request reviews, automated testing and pipeline-driven deployments.
  • Agent-assisted and spec-driven development in daily practice (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist).
  • Building APIs or MCP servers to expose automation.
  • IaC for networking, security, Kubernetes, and data pipelines and warehouses.
  • Testing infrastructure code: unit, integration and policy tests.
  • Presales experience: scoping, estimating and presenting solutions.
  • Strong communication and client-facing skills.

What will make you a strong candidate:

  • MLOps/LLMOps or agentic AI platform experience.
  • Building internal developer platforms or self-service portals.
  • Policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA or Sentinel.
  • Open-source contributions or published reusable modules.
  • Cloud architect certifications (Google Cloud, Azure or AWS).

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

Job Title: Director, Social Media & Influencer Marketing

Location: Remote

Company Summary

At Vytalogy, we believe everyone should have access to better health and nutrition to fuel their wellness. As a leader in the vitamins, minerals, and supplements (VMS) industry, we're home to trusted brands Natrol and Jarrow Formulas. With locations in Los Angeles, CA, Boulder, CO, and Haslet, TX, we bring science-backed wellness products to consumers nationwide.

Summary:

The Director, Social Media & Influencer Marketing will lead social media, creator, influencer and community marketing across Vytalogy's portfolio of brands, with primary emphasis on Natrol. This role will build a connected social and creator capability that translates brand strategy into culturally relevant content and consumer experiences across organic social, paid amplification, affiliate, community and social commerce. The Director will partner across Brand, eCommerce, Shopper Marketing and PR to strengthen brand relevance, deepen consumer engagement and contribute to measurable business growth across the portfolio.

Your primary activities will include but are not limited to:

  • Develop annual social media, influencer, creator and community strategies aligned with each brand's positioning, target consumer and growth priorities, with primary focus on accelerating Natrol's growth and cultural relevance
  • Define channel roles, content territories, editorial priorities and platform strategies across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and emerging social platforms
  • Translate brand strategy into social-first creative direction, briefs, content calendars and platform-native content
  • Build and lead an integrated creator ecosystem spanning celebrity and macro talent, influencers, micro-creators, ambassadors, affiliates and user-generated content
  • Develop always-on creator, ambassador and community programs that increase brand advocacy, content generation, engagement and reach
  • Partner with Brand Marketing to identify high-performing organic and creator content, secure appropriate usage rights and scale winning content through paid media
  • Partner with eCommerce to connect creator and social programs with DTC, retailer eCommerce, affiliate and social-commerce opportunities, including TikTok Shop
  • Partner with Brand Marketing to integrate social, influencer and creator strategies into brand campaigns, product launches and annual marketing plans
  • Partner with Shopper Marketing to extend relevant creator and social programs into retailer and omnichannel activations
  • Lead social listening, community management and cultural-trend identification to inform content and brand opportunities
  • Establish content, brand-safety, regulatory, usage-rights and approval standards for social and creator programs
  • Manage social media, influencer and creator agencies, technology partners, scopes of work, budgets and performance
  • Establish measurement frameworks and evaluate reach, engagement, content effectiveness, brand impact, traffic, conversion, affiliate performance and return on investment
  • Build scalable processes, tools and operating models that connect social, creator, paid media, commerce and brand teams
  • Lead and develop internal social, content and community resources as the capability grows

Role Scope:

This role owns organic social media strategy, influencer and creator marketing, social-first content, community strategy, ambassador programs and creator partnerships across Vytalogy's portfolio, with Natrol as the primary brand focus. The role will establish scalable capabilities and standards that can support Jarrow Formulas and other Vytalogy brands based on business priorities. It partners closely with Marketing and eCommerce on paid social amplification and campaign optimization, affiliate and social-commerce execution, brand positioning, campaigns and creative strategy.

You'll need the following (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in social media, influencer and creator marketing, integrated media, content marketing or a related consumer-marketing discipline
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly evolving social, creator, influencer, ambassador or community-marketing capabilities
  • Experience developing differentiated social and content strategies across multiple consumer brands
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and emerging social platforms
  • Experience across the creator spectrum, including celebrity talent, influencers, micro-creators, user-generated content, ambassadors and affiliates
  • Experience connecting organic and creator content with paid media, performance marketing, eCommerce, retail and social commerce
  • Strong understanding of creator contracting, usage rights, brand safety, content approval and influencer measurement
  • Experience managing significant budgets, agencies and complex cross-functional programs
  • Strong analytical skills and experience measuring brand, engagement, content, commerce and return-on-investment outcomes
  • Strong leadership, communication and influencing skills with the ability to work across Brand, Creative, eCommerce, Shopper Marketing, PR, Media and senior leadership
  • Demonstrated success building new capabilities and operating effectively in an evolving, high-accountability environment
  • Experience in vitamins, minerals and supplements, consumer health, wellness, nutrition, food, beauty, personal care or another regulated consumer category preferred

A reasonable estimate of the current salary range for this position is $185,000 to $205,000. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Vytalogy Wellness LLC offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K with company matching contributions, paid sick days, vacation, holidays, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and wellness programs.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Commercial Servicing
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Vice President of Commercial Servicing sets the strategic leadership and executive oversight for the Commercial Servicing platform, including primary servicing, special servicing, portfolio management, operational controls, and oversight of the shared-service functions that support commercial loan servicing.
jobs.description:
The Senior Vice President of Commercial Servicing sets the strategic leadership and executive oversight for the Commercial Servicing platform, including primary servicing, special servicing, portfolio management, operational controls, and oversight of the shared-service functions that support commercial loan servicing. This leader is accountable for building a scalable, high-performing platform that delivers compliant, efficient servicing, strong credit and asset-resolution outcomes, exceptional client experiences, and sustainable growth and profitability.

This position will establish the strategy, operating model, governance, talent, technology, and financial discipline required to support portfolio growth, new client on-boarding, securitization readiness, and the continued development of the loan servicing technology platforms and related servicing capabilities.

This highly visible role interfaces with executive leadership and represents Commercial Servicing with clients, investors, rating agencies, regulators, auditors, vendors, financing counterparties, and other external stakeholders. The position is responsible for balancing growth, service excellence, risk management, credit judgment, liquidity and advancing requirements, customer outcomes, and shareholder returns.

Job Functions and Responsibilities:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

  • Develop and execute the short- and long-term strategy for Commercial Servicing
  • Align servicing objectives with corporate growth, client, operational, financial, and risk-management goals.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing leadership team with clear accountability and succession planning.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Own the Commercial Servicing P&L performance; develop and manage budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, and investment priorities.
  • Provide executive oversight of portfolio performance, delinquencies, watch-list activity, advancing, liquidity, recoverability, credit risk, asset resolutions, loss mitigation, foreclosure, bankruptcy, REO, and special-servicing strategies.
  • Act as executive relationship manager for key clients, investors, special servicers, directing certificate holders, rating agencies, auditors, regulators, vendors, and financing partners; maintain regular contact and lead resolution of significant issues.
  • Drive operating excellence through process redesign, automation, data analytics, artificial intelligence, standardized controls, quality assurance, and technology modernization, including continued optimization of proprietary commercial technology platforms.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, contractual, investor, licensing, and internal governance requirements.
  • Oversee the proactive identification, assessment, mitigation, and reporting of key business risks, including operational, regulatory, credit, technology, vendor, information security, and reputational exposures.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of executive communications, business reviews, portfolio and financial analytics, strategic insights, client updates, and rating agency materials to support informed decision-making and stakeholder engagement

Key Result Areas:

  • Achieve portfolio growth, client retention, revenue, profitability, and return objectives while maintaining disciplined expense and advancing management.
  • Successfully onboard new clients, portfolios, products, and asset classes while maintaining service quality, operational stability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Improve portfolio performance by reducing delinquencies, accelerating asset resolution timelines, maximizing advance recoveries, strengthening watchlist management, and minimizing credit losses.
  • Increase organizational scalability, productivity, and cost efficiency through process standardization, automation, artificial intelligence, technology modernization, and data-driven decision making.
  • Enhance client, investor, rating-agency, and stakeholder satisfaction through strong service delivery, transparent communication, and effective relationship management.
  • Strengthening the commercial servicing platform's market position by supporting business development initiatives, securitization readiness, strategic partnerships, and expansion into targeted commercial and business-purpose lending segments.
  • Develop and retain a high-performing leadership team by building organizational capability, succession plans, accountability, and employee engagement.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must have the following education and/or experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, or a related field (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree or relevant professional designation preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in commercial real estate finance, commercial loan servicing, special servicing, asset management, structured finance, or related financial services.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing growth strategies that drive portfolio expansion, revenue growth, profitability, market penetration, client acquisition, and new product introduction.
  • Proven experience scaling servicing platforms through subservicing relationships, client onboarding, operating model design, and large-scale business transformation.
  • Deep expertise in commercial and business-purpose loan servicing, including small-balance commercial, DSCR, RTL/fix-and-flip, SFR, multi-property, Multi-family, CRE, CMBS securitizations, subserviced – Master, Primary, and special-serviced portfolios.
  • Strong financial, accounting, and operational management skills, including P&L ownership, budgeting, forecasting, servicing economics, liquidity and advance management, resource allocation, valuation, and return-on-investment analysis.
  • Proven ability to leverage technology, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and process improvement methodologies to enhance scalability, productivity, controls, client experience, and business performance.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate complex financial, operational, credit, and risk-related matters and translate insights into actionable business decisions.
  • Exceptional executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence across executive leadership, boards, clients, investors, regulators, rating agencies, and strategic partners.
  • Proven ability to lead high-performing organizations, develop leadership talent, drive accountability, and successfully manage change in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple locations and time zones and travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, the successful candidate may be required to satisfy client-specific background screening or federal/state licensing requirements, if applicable.

The salary range for this position is expected to be $220,000 – $250,000 per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for bonus and long-term incentive compensation awards based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.

jobs.description:
About Channel Fusion

Founded more than 20 years ago, Channel Fusion provides brands and their channel partners with an ecosystem of channel marketing technologies, solutions and services. By coupling innovative technologies, industry expertise and a relentless customer-focused support team, we provide a unique combination of platforms, products and people.

Our purpose is simple: inspire our clients to achieve their desired outcomes by transforming channel marketing into impactful business results. We do this by ensuring an understanding of your desired outcomes first and then deploying tailored solutions using a disciplined process to achieve those outcomes.

Once a program is operational, our support team of Fusers becomes an extension of your brand to ensure your channel partners have an optimal customer experience while maximizing their marketing investment in your brand. Our account leadership teams stay involved every step of the way to ensure programs continue to exceed expectations and drive your desired outcomes.

About the Role

Channel Fusion is building and growing the infrastructure that powers co-op marketing programs for enterprise brands and their dealer networks. As a Bilingual Client Program Specialist, you will be the front-line partner for French and English-speaking clients by helping dealers optimize their marketing investments, navigate program guidelines, and trust that their claims and preapprovals are handled with accuracy and care.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in both the quality of their client relationships and the precision of their operational work. You'll be measured on claims accuracy and processing speed against SLA. AI tools are part of how you'll hit those numbers. This is a role where the numbers are visible and matter.

Ownership & Scope

You Own

You Do NOT Own

  • French/English client communication and relationship continuity
  • Day-to-day dealer support across inbound and outbound channels
  • Claims processing and preapproval decisions within program guidelines
  • Review of French-language marketing materials for brand and program compliance
  • Co-op budget optimization guidance for dealer partners
  • Dealer training and portal navigation coaching
  • Accuracy and efficiency metrics on your case load
  • Payment support coordination with the internal finance team and vendors (reissues, cancellations, payment tracking)
  • Program rule design or client contract terms are owned by Client Program Leads
  • Technical platform issues or site defects are owned by Engineering/IT
  • Marketing strategy for dealers: you advise on compliance.
  • Final escalation authority on disputed claims is owned by Client Program Leads

What You'll Do

Claims & Preapproval Processing

  • Claims & Preapproval Review: apply each client's specific program guidelines to review claims and preapproval requests. In co-op programs, the claim submission is the marketing material; reviewing it for brand and program compliance is the mechanism by which the claim decision gets made.
  • Process claims and preapprovals within defined SLA timeframes.
  • Maintain accuracy and processing efficiency as core performance metrics; this role is measured quantitatively as well as qualitatively.

Customer & Dealer Support

  • Provide direct customer support across phone, email, and chat for client programs, handling inbound questions and issues as they arrive.
  • Follow documented company standards and procedures for support interactions, by channel.
  • Complete tickets and follow-ups within defined SLA timeframes.
  • Coordinate with internal finance team and vendors to track down payment details and set up reissues and cancellations, and be prepared to walk the customer through the process.

Knowledge & Dealer Enablement

  • Continuously expand your knowledge of co-op marketing practices, industry trends, and compliance requirements. This is an ongoing professional development expectation.
  • Train and coach dealers and agencies to navigate and execute co-op activities through online portals.

Culture & Continuous Improvement

  • Role model a customer-centric, collaborative culture, reinforcing team values through behavior.
  • Notice and contribute to operational efficiency improvements in processes, beyond your own casework.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bilingual fluency in French and English (speaking, reading, and writing), required for dealer communication and French language material review.
  • Comfortable making judgment calls on claim compliance against written program guidelines, and explaining that judgment to a dealer who disagrees with it.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and a customer-first orientation.

Preferred

  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing, program administration, or operations role — B2B experience a plus.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, or marketing analytics tools.
  • Knowledge of co-op marketing programs, guidelines, and compliance requirements.
  • Comfort using AI tools to improve productivity and communication workflows.

About Cozey
At Cozey, we're building a world-class organization with the ambition to become the world's leading furniture company. We're diligent, innovative, and relentless about empowering more possibilities in our customers' homes and making furniture shopping as easy as possible, so that they can simply focus on enjoying their homes. Our commonsense furniture innovations adapt to evolving lifestyles, combining ingenuity with a commitment to great value and customer service. As a fast-growing company, our success is driven by a team that shares our passion for redefining the furniture experience and building a world-class brand. That same growth is why we're looking for a Senior Supply Planner to make sure the right products are in the right place at the right time, so every customer gets the fast, reliable experience they expect from Cozey.

The Mission of the Senior Supply and Inventory Planning Analyst at Cozey

Reporting to our Manager, Supply Planning, you'll decide how much inventory Cozey buys and where it sits. You'll turn demand forecasts into buy and deployment plans across our fulfillment centers, and weigh in-stock against working capital every week. You'll be the person leadership trusts to recommend what we buy, when, and why.

This is a remote role open to candidates across Canada. Please note that our team works core hours in Eastern Time (ET), so you'll need to be available during those hours.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end supply planning for an assigned portfolio of products, suppliers, and markets, and keep a strong weekly planning rhythm as Cozey scales.
  • Translate demand forecasts into purchasing requirements and replenishment strategies across SKUs, suppliers, and distribution nodes, accounting for lead times, MOQs, and supplier constraints.
  • Own days of inventory on hand for your portfolio. Decide where inventory sits, balancing service levels, working capital, and cost through decisions on safety stock, order sizing, expedites, and allocation; monitor stockouts and excess or slow-moving inventory, and correct course as needed.
  • Continuously optimize planning parameters, including lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and batch sizes, based on observed performance and variability.
  • Partner with Sourcing and Operations to monitor supplier lead times, capacity, reliability, and fill rates, providing the forecasts, order requirements, and planning insights needed to support supplier discussions and drive corrective action when performance falls short.
  • Prepare and present supply risks, constraints, and recommendations (expedites, reallocation, buys, order changes) to support S&OP decision-making.
  • Partner with Demand Planning, Product, Operations, and Finance on product launches, lifecycle transitions, and discontinuations to ensure clean, in-stock execution.
  • Shape our in-house planning tools with Data Science and Engineering: define the logic, test it against real decisions, and flag where it breaks.

We'd Love to Hear from You If You Have

  • 4+ years of experience in supply planning, inventory planning, operations, or supply chain analytics in retail, e-commerce, or CPG, including experience operating in complex environments with global sourcing and long lead times.
  • Strong supply planning fundamentals: replenishment logic, safety stock, lead times, MOQ constraints, and service level trade-offs.
  • Strong analytical and technical skills, including advanced Excel, a working knowledge of SQL, and comfort with planning systems and BI tools, paired with attention to detail: clean data, accurate parameters, and reliable execution with minimal downstream rework.
  • Experience using automation and AI-enabled tools to improve planning workflows, analyze large datasets, and accelerate decision-making.
  • An operational mindset, understanding how plans play out across sourcing, production, warehouses, and transportation.
  • Clear, structured communication that lays out the issue, impact, options, and recommendation, paired with a bias for action: spotting risks early and driving fixes before they hit service or inventory.

You'll Know You're Successful When

  • Inventory is healthy across your scope: strong in-stock performance, with excess and obsolescence under control.
  • Supply plans are reliable and realistic, aligned with operational constraints, with minimal last-minute firefighting.
  • Risks like capacity, delays, or shortages are caught early, and your recommendations turn into real action.
  • Supplier performance risks are visible and addressed proactively in partnership with Sourcing, including lead-time variability, fill-rate issues, and capacity constraints.
  • Planning parameters keep improving, and that shows up in better performance over time.
  • Leaders trust your supply plan enough to make purchasing and inventory decisions against it.

We Care About You

  • You will receive a competitive salary along with a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Real influence over how Cozey plans, buys, and grows its inventory, with decisions that directly shape the business.
  • Endless opportunities for personal and professional growth in a fast-growing, ambitious company.
  • A generous PTO policy that gives you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible, people-first workspace where you're surrounded by smart, kind, and humble colleagues.

These tools help us focus our time where it matters most: getting to know candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people, and we're committed to a fair and inclusive process.

Emergent Software is seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead the planning and delivery of custom software solutions for enterprise clients. Primary Duties

  • Partner with Clients

    • Partner with clients to assist them in performing the Product Owner role.

    • Facilitate in-depth requirements gathering and analysis.

    • Document requirements as Features and User Stories to share with team.

    • Work with your team and client to create a plan for delivering on project objectives and achieving business value.

  • Partner with the Product Delivery Team

    • Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to colleagues in the Product Delivery Team.

    • Drive innovation and adoption of AI tooling in product development and delivery.

    • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and a community of practitioners.

    • Help craft future product offerings or client engagement options.

  • Partner with Sales

    • Lead product development activities for key/strategic client pursuits.

    • Present solution vision proposals to client executives.

    • Work with account executives on client satisfaction efforts in existing delivery engagements.

  • Partner with Technology Teams

    • Establish client technology roadmap.

  • Partner with Delivery Teams

    • Communicate technical and business requirements to delivery team.

    • Collaborate with senior delivery team members to solve complex challenges.

    • Demonstrate strong understanding of custom software development concepts and best practices in all interactions.

    • Ensure projects stay on target by regularly communicating status, risks, and change as they occur.

  • Be a Champion of the Agile Software Development Process

    • Work directly with clients to manage project delivery while encouraging and fostering an agile delivery method.

    • Apply agile concepts in real world settings, adapting principles to client’s level of agile sophistication and working to improve maturity over time.

    • Own backlog health and communicate deviation to expected value delivery proactively.

    • Act as a servant leader to your delivery team.

Required Qualifications

  • Product Ownership Experience

    • 7+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager

    • Experience in delivering custom enterprise software solutions across a variety of technologies, platforms, and hosting paradigms.

    • Experience in crafting cost estimates to deliver components or entire projects.

    • Strong technical writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills are a must.

    • Experience operating as the liaison between agile development teams and users in defining requirements, performing business analysis, and driving delivery in the right direction.

  • Technology Knowledge

    • Experience utilizing AI tools in product development, product delivery, or project management.

    • A solid understanding of how websites, web applications, APIs, databases, and the cloud function at a high level.

    • Strong technical background enabling you to provide credible leadership to development teams and accurately evaluate complex project risks and issues.

  • Experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach

    • Solid understanding of software development life cycle models including expert knowledge of Agile principles.

    • Experience with agile work organization tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello, Basecamp, Rally).

    • A proven track record of successfully implementing custom web application projects using Agile methodologies.

  • Experience with Traditional Project Management Concepts

    • Experience with scope, schedule, budget, and risk management.

    • Must be viewed as a trusted source of truth by stakeholders through consistent, transparent, and confident communication.

    • Owns the narrative around project delivery, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and reassured throughout the lifecycle.

  • Occasional travel to client sites may be requested for activities such as annual planning meetings. Although travel is not expected to be frequent, the ability to accommodate occasional travel is required.

    • Scrum master turned product owner.

    • Independent consultant with previous experience on agile delivery teams (any role).

    • Someone who is a product owner with a passion for the technical side of software development.

At Emergent Software, we work hard to find the best analysts capable of delivering high quality software for our clients. If you think you’re one of those, please understand that the effort put into this by people like yourself helps us be successful in surrounding you with other top-notch people. Wanderlog is hiring a full-time engineer to help build and scale our web and mobile travel planning products. This is a permanent, full-time role reporting to the co-founders at Wanderlog.
Role details

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Location: Remote — United States

  • Reports to: Co-founders

  • Salary range: $70,000 - $100,000 USD, depending on experience

About Wanderlog

Wanderlog helps make leisure travel easier. We believe that travel makes the world better, and are building tools that lower the bar to it.

Our core product, built starting in 2019, is a travel planning app, but we’re also helping travelers book hotels (without hidden fees), providing them with information through pages such as best attractions and restaurants, and more.

We’re a small, engineering- and product-driven team building tools used by travelers worldwide.

Wanderlog was founded by twin brothers Peter Xu (ex-Stripe, McKinsey) and Harry Yu (ex-Google), who previously built successful travel products before starting Wanderlog.

What you'll do

As an engineer, you’ll be responsible for owning portions of the product. You’ll be expected to:

  • Build new features on our website and mobile app. (Our stack is Javascript (Typescript): modern React on the web, React Native on mobile, and Node.js/Express on the server.)
  • Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
  • Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
  • Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
  • Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
  • Review code written by other engineers.
  • Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.
What you might work on
  • New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
  • AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
  • Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
  • A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
  • Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
  • A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.
What it's like to work here

We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.

Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.

We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.

Hiring process
  • Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
  • A live coding interview with one of the founders
  • A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call

Requirements

  • Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
  • Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
  • Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
  • Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
  • Love travel and believe in it as a positive force personally and for the world.

Benefits

  • Medical
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • FSA or HSA plans
  • Paid sick leave
