jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.excerpt: About Curve Dental: Curve Dental is the leading provider of cloud-based, all-in-one dental practice management software for dental professionals and practices of all sizes across the United States and Canada.
jobs.description:
About Curve Dental:

Curve Dental is the leading provider of cloud-based, all-in-one dental practice management software for dental professionals and practices of all sizes across the United States and Canada. With powerful features like imaging, scheduling, billing, patient engagement, and more, Curve empowers dental professionals to optimize practice efficiency and elevate patient experiences—all from one easy-to-use platform and industry-disrupting mobile app.

Position Summary

We are seeking a software developer who is passionate about software development and technically excellent. Our developers work across the full stack — C#/.NET backend services and TypeScript/Angular front-end applications — and understand that a project is not done until it has been deployed to production for our users. We want developers who can contribute positively to our culture and teach us things we didn't know before. Those same developers are always hungry to learn and improve in any way they can.

Our developers take a leadership role in stewarding the code to ever higher standards, mentoring other developers on the team and driving forward the technical direction of both Curve and its products.

You'll own features from design through production, and take on larger, more open-ended problems as you grow with the team.

Things we're looking for in terms of more specific skill-sets and experience:

  • BS in Computer Science or related technical discipline (or equivalent)
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience
  • Solid backend programming experience in C#/.NET, or a comparable language such as Java
  • Solid front-end programming experience in TypeScript with a modern framework (Angular preferred)
  • A solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design
  • Strong SQL and relational database skills — complex queries, schema design, transactions, and writing production-safe data migrations
  • Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting production issues end-to-end (backend and frontend) with root cause analysis
  • Experience writing secure code in a data-sensitive or regulated environment, such as one handling PHI, PII, or financial data
  • Previous experience with agile development methodologies, unit testing with tools like xUnit/NUnit or Playwright, and code reviews
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Copilot, and critically reviewing their output rather than accepting it at face value

Nice to have experience:

  • Experience with large-scale data migration or integration systems
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and messaging/queueing systems (AWS or similar)
  • Exposure to healthcare or other regulated data environments

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist - Japanese speaker
jobs.excerpt: The Red Hat Customer Experience and Engagement (CEE) team is looking for a Customer Support Specialist with fluent Japanese/Mandarin/English to join us in APAC.
jobs.description:
The Red Hat Customer Experience and Engagement (CEE) team is looking for a Customer Support Specialist with fluent Japanese/Mandarin/English to join us in APAC.

The core responsibility of a Customer Service Representative is to provide our global enterprise customers with the specific focus on customers based in Japan with high-quality assistance and support regarding their account and subscription management.

You will act as a vital link between customers and various internal stakeholders to ensure smooth problem resolution. This role requires the ability to handle a diverse range of Non-technical inquiries with sound judgment and effective communication, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction through proactive problem-solving.

What you will do

Customer Support & Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Red Hat enterprise customers globally, primary Japanese customers, handling inquiries through phone and email regarding products and services.

  • Manage initial customer interactions and coordinate seamless communication between customers and internal teams.

Problem solving & Documentation

  • Perform diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of customer issues, escalating complex problems when necessary.

  • Research customer issues thoroughly and contribute to the team's knowledge base by recording solutions and documenting new knowledge articles.

Teamwork & Proactivity

  • Work effectively as a collaborative, remote team member, maintaining a customer-first mindset.

  • Actively seek and implement proactive solutions to enhance the customer experience.

What you will bring

  • Native-level fluency in Japanese (both written and verbal) is essential for providing high-quality professional guidance to our enterprise customers in a Japanese business environment.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills are also required.

  • Verbal and written Mandarin communication skills are plus

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Customer Service industry.

  • An IT degree or background in the IT industry is a plus.

  • Exceptional customer service skills, including experience managing multiple priorities in a customer-facing role.

  • A strong passion for problem-solving and investigation, coupled with the ability to critically analyze complex issues.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize work effectively and perform under pressure.

  • Some experience using Linux is an advantage, but not a requirement.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.


Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

jobs.excerpt: Please be advised: Visio Lending does not accept unsolicited resumes or services from third-party recruitment agencies.
jobs.description:
Please be advised: Visio Lending does not accept unsolicited resumes or services from third-party recruitment agencies. In the event, a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Visio Lending shall explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to Visio Lending employees, shall be deemed the property of Visio Lending.

About Visio Lending

Visio Lending is the nation’s leader in rental home financing. Founded in 2012 in Austin, Texas, Visio enables small- to medium- sized investors to grow their rental home, vacation rental, and small balance commercial portfolios. Headquartered in fantastic Austin, Texas, since late 2015, Visio has financed more than $1 billion in Rental360 loans. With more than $400 million in capital onboard, a proven record of investment grade bond issuance on Wall Street, and an outstanding 100+ team, Visio is poised for continued success.

Why We Love Working at Visio:

We at Visio are passionate about working together towards our goals to continually push this company forward. We innovate, collaborate, celebrate team successes, and recognize individual accomplishments. At Visio Lending, you’ll work on meaningful initiatives that directly support real estate investors nationwide. We offer a collaborative culture, growth opportunities, and flexibility with remote work options.

How to Apply?

To be considered for employment, please submit your application online. While we appreciate all the interest we receive, only candidates selected for phone screening, or an interview will be contacted directly. You will receive application status alerts via email so make sure your email address is accurate.

Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. Unanswered application questions or responses indicating “see resume” will be considered incomplete and you will be removed from consideration.

Visio Financial Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Opportunity

The Project Manager will lead and coordinate mortgage-focused initiatives that support business growth, operational excellence, platform readiness, and successful execution across the organization. This role is responsible for bringing structure, accountability, and momentum to cross-functional projects while applying Agile practices where appropriate.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented project leader who can balance flexibility with disciplined delivery, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do

  • Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and success measures in partnership with stakeholders
  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through delivery, ensuring alignment with business goals, technical feasibility, and organizational priorities
  • Provide clear, consistent, and timely project communication, including status updates, risks, issues, decisions, and executive-level reporting
  • Develop and maintain project plans, documentation, budgets, resource needs, and governance materials throughout the project lifecycle
  • Coordinate evaluation of process, technology, hardware, and software options, including cost-benefit considerations and implementation impacts
  • Identify, document, monitor, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies, and process control needs; escalate appropriately when impacts may affect delivery
  • Track project performance against short-term and long-term goals, using data and metrics to identify trends, drive accountability, and support informed decision-making
  • Lead mortgage-related projects using Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate for the initiative
  • Facilitate or assist in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, demos, backlog reviews, and prioritization discussions
  • Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage backlogs, remove impediments, coordinate UAT, and support successful adoption
  • Work independently and collaboratively across multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Recommend improvements to project execution, team collaboration, process maturity, and operational effectiveness
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned based on business needs
  • Authorized Remote Locations: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, NC, SC, TX, UT
  • Salary Range: $90,000 - $111,000/yr (Exempt/Salaried)

What We Are Looking For:

  • 3 + years leading technical, non-technical, and enterprise projects in the mortgage industry
  • Working knowledge of Agile methodologies, delivery practices, ceremonies, and team collaboration models

jobs.excerpt: Senior Technical Animator, Defcon Zero | TriArts Games | Remote Join the team building Defcon Zero, a high-fidelity RTS powered by Unreal Engine 5.
jobs.description:
Senior Technical Animator, Defcon Zero | TriArts Games | Remote

Join the team building Defcon Zero, a high-fidelity RTS powered by Unreal Engine 5.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Animator to own the technical animation pipeline, from production-ready rigs and animation tools to runtime systems inside Unreal Engine 5. You will help define how soldiers, vehicles, mechanical units, and creatures move, fight, and behave, while ensuring every system remains responsive and performant at RTS scale.

You will have direct ownership, work closely with both artists and developers, and see your work reflected throughout the final game.

What you'll own

  • Runtime animation systems: Animation Blueprints, state machines, montages, notifies, blending, IK, retargeting, and procedural animation
  • Character and unit rigs: Production-ready rigs for humanoids, creatures, vehicles, weapons, and mechanical gameplay assets
  • Gameplay integration: Locomotion, combat animations, hit reactions, unit states, transitions, and animation-driven gameplay events
  • Animation pipeline: Reliable workflows between Maya and Unreal Engine 5, including importing, validation, retargeting, and automation
  • Tools development: Custom tools and scripts that improve iteration speed for animators, artists, and designers
  • Performance and optimisation: Profiling and optimising animation systems for large numbers of simultaneously active RTS units
  • Technical problem-solving: Diagnosing rigging, deformation, animation, export, and runtime issues across the production pipeline
  • Standards and documentation: Establishing scalable technical standards that keep animation production consistent across the project

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in technical animation, character rigging, or runtime animation for games
  • Strong professional experience with Unreal Engine 5 animation systems
  • Advanced knowledge of Animation Blueprints, Control Rig, IK Rig, IK Retargeter, state machines, montages, and animation notifies
  • Strong rigging, skinning, deformation, and animation pipeline experience in Maya
  • Professional experience rigging and implementing non-humanoid creatures, mechanical units, and vehicles
  • Experience building tools and automating workflows using Python, MEL, Blueprints, or similar scripting solutions
  • Solid understanding of runtime animation performance, profiling, LOD systems, and optimisation
  • Experience integrating animation with gameplay systems
  • Shipped a complete game or made a significant contribution to a shipped title
  • Able to work independently while collaborating closely with animators, artists, designers, and developers
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

Nice to have

  • Experience with Unreal Engine's Animation Budget Allocator, Update Rate Optimisation, or Animation Sharing systems
  • Experience with Full Body IK, Motion Warping, Pose Search, Motion Matching, or procedural locomotion
  • Working knowledge of C++ and custom Unreal Engine editor plugins
  • Experience developing animation systems for RTS, strategy, or games with high on-screen unit counts
  • A passion for the RTS genre

Who you are

  • You understand both the artistic and technical sides of animation
  • You can translate visual goals into stable, scalable runtime systems
  • You identify pipeline problems early and take ownership of solving them
  • You approach debugging methodically and communicate your findings clearly
  • You collaborate proactively across departments
  • You treat feedback as a tool for growth, not as personal criticism
  • You can independently learn and introduce new tools, workflows, and production methods

What we offer

  1. The Forefront of PC Development: Move beyond the mobile market and join one of the few studios in Israel building a high-fidelity, hardcore PC strategy game with the latest Unreal Engine technology.
  2. Fully Remote: Work remotely in a production environment built around clear communication, personal ownership, and focused collaboration.
  3. A Veteran Team: Work alongside passionate developers and artists who care deeply about the RTS genre and maintain high artistic and technical standards.
  4. Growth Potential: Grow alongside the studio. As Defcon Zero expands, so will your influence, ownership, and responsibility.
  5. Direct Impact: You will not be a small part of a massive hierarchy. Your systems will directly shape how every unit moves, responds, and performs in the final game.
  6. Collaborative Culture: Join a dedicated team of gamers, artists, and developers in a friendly, grounded environment built around the professional standards required to ship a top-tier title.

jobs.title: Solar Technician III
jobs.excerpt: The Solar Technician III is a seasoned technician/professional that demonstrates a strong working knowledge of both AC/DC electrical and Data Acquisition/Monitoring systems on distributed generation scale solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants.
jobs.description:
The Solar Technician III is a seasoned technician/professional that demonstrates a strong working knowledge of both AC/DC electrical and Data Acquisition/Monitoring systems on distributed generation scale solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants. They will be responsible for corrective maintenance and operation of assigned solar projects to ensure optimal generation performance of the company’s solar photovoltaic (PV) plant portfolio. Overall responsibilities will include routine maintenance on solar equipment, providing oversight for complex work, assisting with technical project scope creation, and maintaining records of completed tasks and equipment status. Troubleshoot solar equipment safely with minimal help and supervision.

The Solar Tech III will work closely with the Operations/Asset Management teams to safely achieve overall Solar performance goals. This position will be remote and will cover projects throughout MA, CT, RI, with occasional support in northern NY.

Responsibilities Overview

  • The Solar Technician III is responsible for troubleshooting and repairing all equipment associated with solar facilities up to the medium voltage equipment.
  • Work safely under all circumstances, seek guidance regarding unfamiliar work to ensure safety and understanding of tasks to be performed
  • Manage work order system to ensure assign sites meet or exceed the weather adjusted performance targets, monitor assigned sites.
  • Keep track of work performed and update work orders.
  • Perform “status” checks including clearing “error” codes on solar equipment, make necessary repairs under supervision.
  • Respond “on-call” as directed by supervisor to assist in emergency equipment repairs
  • Performs/assists with technical and administrative duties associated with operating and maintaining a solar portfolio.
  • Attention to detail and safety focused
  • Perform advanced level troubleshooting for component repair and replacements with proficient use of specialized tools and diagnostic processes
  • Perform QA/QC inspections in accordance with applicable SOP
  • Assist Project managers and Asset managers with technical scope creation and root cause analysis
  • Safely measure DC and AC voltage and current utilizing a multimeter meter.
  • Replace or repair solar parts and/or equipment with no supervision
  • Understand electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic functions of all components of solar site and associated equipment.
  • Ensures work is performed in accordance with Environmental and Safety requirements.
  • May perform work independently and/or in work crews, depending upon skills and experience.
  • Maintain company tooling, facilities and equipment and a clean safe work environment
  • Identify electrical, environmental, and safety hazards associated with photovoltaic (PV) installations.
  • Become part of the team and prepared to learn new tasks.
  • Perform additional duties as required
  • Overnight travel as needed
  • Conduct maintenance of equipment (fueling, lubrication, etc.)
  • Lift and move equipment as needed (up to 50 pounds)
  • Responsible for the operation and maintenance of solar power plants in accordance with established standards and procedures; always maintains safety and professionalism
  • Provide a working knowledge of troubleshooting electrical components with help and use of digital multi-meters, meggers, amp clamps, and similar equipment. Tests installed equipment, ensuring proper working order including daily mechanical electrical inspections

Basic Qualifications

  • Knowledgeable technician/professional with four or more years of experience with solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of SCADA, DAS and communication networks, protocols, and software.
  • Demonstrate commitment and participation in developing an accident-free work environment
  • Effective communication skills both written and verbal
  • Technical understanding of solar generation and energy storage
  • In field / hands on experience in solar construction and operation
  • Experience with electrical systems and familiarity of basic safety principles to include LOTO, Arc Flash and Electrical Safety.
  • Knowledge of AC/DC electrical systems and tools
  • Proven ability to work well within a multi-disciplinary team
  • Must be able to work outdoors in inclement weather
  • Ability to understand directions, follow procedures, and complete tasks with minimal oversight
  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.
  • Remain current in all safety and technical trainings
  • Knowledge of applicable safety and environmental regulations
  • Knowledge of electrical testing and equipment used at solar facilities including but not limited to; IR equipment and IV curve tracing.
  • Working knowledge of Solectria, SMA, Satcon, Advanced Energy/PVP central inverters
  • Working knowledge of Also Energy, Power Factors, MOXA, and SEEDS DAS equipment
  • Working knowledge of SEL protective devices
  • Working knowledge of MV Transformers and Switchgear

Preferred Qualifications

  • NABCEP PV Installer or Commissioning & Maintenance Specialist
  • OSHA – 30 Hour Certificate Holder
  • NFPA 70E Certificate Holder
  • AAS degree in electrical technology or equivalent
  • State Electrical license or training certificate

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day.
jobs.description:
ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day. Sound simple? We strive to keep it that way! Our mission is to give schools the power to incredibly enhance family engagement for all students. ParentSquare and RemindHub, our flagship products, serve over 22 million students and drive our mission by providing unified communications tools -forms, sign ups, payments, RSVPs, direct messaging, language translations, chat and more. Remind Chat, our free product, reaches over 80% of K-12 students, providing a safe and easy-to-use platform for direct communication between teachers and families. And our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts, enhancing their online presence and accessibility.

Nearly 1 in 4 students nationwide are chronically absent, making chronic absenteeism one of the highest-stakes challenges districts face. Attendance affects funding, academic outcomes, and long-term student success.

ParentSquare Attendance Plus is our answer: a proactive, relationship-driven solution built directly into the platform districts already use, giving attendance teams tiered data insights, family outreach, and intervention tracking in one place. Since launching, Attendance Plus has earned industry recognition, including Tech & Learning's Best of 2025, and has become one of the fastest-growing lines in the ParentSquare platform.

We are not just creating products; we are creating empowered educators and engaged families to improve the lives of students. We are passionate advocates for our customers and our employees, and we invite you to join us on this journey.

Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who will own the market strategy for Attendance Plus. You'll go deep on the chronic absenteeism problem itself—the research, the district budget cycles, the competitive landscape—and use that expertise to shape where Attendance Plus goes next.

You'll own positioning and messaging for the entire attendance line, translate the needs of attendance clerks, counselors, and district administrators into a narrative that resonates through the whole buying committee, and make the call on which capabilities deserve a full go-to-market push versus a quiet rollout. You'll partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on packaging, pricing, and competitive strategy for the line.

Success in this role means the market understands why Attendance Plus is different, our go-to-market teams know how to win attendance conversations, and customer and competitive insights consistently shape what we build and how we take it to market. You'll be accountable not just for launches but also for helping to grow Attendance Plus as a business.

In This Role You'll:

  • Own the market strategy for Attendance Plus
    • Own positioning and messaging for Attendance Plus, translating chronic absenteeism research and district pain points into a value proposition that’s aligned internally and resonates with superintendents, student services, attendance clerks, and school boards alike.
    • Become an internal expert on the attendance and chronic absenteeism market, including state-level attendance-based funding formulas, district budget cycles, buying dynamics, emerging trends, and the competitive landscape.
    • Partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on pricing, packaging, and segmentation for the line, bringing the voice of the market into build and prioritization conversations.
    • Identify the highest-potential segments, use cases, and growth opportunities for Attendance Plus and develop strategies to reach them.
  • Drive go-to-market for roadmap
    • Work with GTM teams to execute plans for new Attendance Plus capabilities, determining the level of investment a release earns based on its strategic weight to the line.
    • Define launch goals and success metrics, then use adoption, customer feedback, field insights, and market response to evaluate performance and inform what comes next.
    • Turn win/loss analysis and customer research into clear insights on why we win, where we lose, and what those insights mean for our product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Enable the field on attendance
    • Partner with Sales Enablement to help the Sales and Customer Success teams win attendance opportunities, including competitive battlecards, buyer-specific messaging, ROI and outcomes framing, and objection handling.
    • Equip Sales and Customer Success teams to confidently communicate new capabilities, positioning shifts, competitive differentiation, and responses to objections.
  • Lead proactively and drive alignment
    • Drive alignment across the Attendance product team, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and leadership, bringing stakeholders together around a shared understanding of the market and a clear narrative for how we win.
    • Surface strategic risks and opportunities early and turn those insights into clear recommendations.

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • Has at least 8 years of product marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of strategy, positioning, and go-to-market for a specific product or line of business.
  • A proven track record of rapidly scaling a new product line through a complex expansion motion that reaches new buyers within existing customer accounts.
  • Brings exceptional drive, high standards, and a winning mindset, with the ability to earn executive sponsorship while building adoption among frontline stakeholders.
  • Has a track record of using customer, market, and competitive insight to influence product or business decisions.
  • Has strong storytelling and written communication skills and can turn complex customer problems and product capabilities into simple, differentiated narratives.
  • Experience with win/loss analysis, customer research, and translating qualitative insight into clear recommendations.
  • Has genuine interest in the chronic absenteeism problem space and willingness to become the internal expert on it.
  • Is willing to travel to industry events and conferences to spend time with customers, prospects, and the broader education community (approximately 20% travel)

The perks of working for us are great!

You’ll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We’re big believers in work-life balance and provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)
  • An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock options
  • Health + wellness reimbursements
  • PTO that increases each year
  • 15 paid holidays, including your birthday!

As a fully remote team, we’ll make sure you have all the tools and equipment you need to make your home office a place where you can thrive.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in compliance with applicable state laws.

The salary range for this role will be $120,000-$165,000 DOE.

Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

With Free2move, you can rent a city car for shopping or for your stay in Italy or book a car park during your weekend in Paris... all in one click, on our web/mobile platform! 📲

Born from the merger of the Stellantis Group 🚗 and the start-up TravelCar, Free2move, thanks to its agility and its spirit of conquest has managed to establish itself in just few years as a reference player to revolutionize the mobility of all travellers.

Having become the #1 reflex for more than 6 million users, Free2move operates in more than 170 countries across different continents 🌎 and is available in 30 languages and 26 currencies. 5000 partners trust us and several hundred thousand vehicles are available!

If you want to join a team of +650 experts and bold international projects, then you're in the right place! 🎯

You will evolve in an ultra-dynamic, innovative, agile, internationally-focused structure and integrate our talented teams, full of ideas and motivation and with multidisciplinary skills, at the crossroads of the digital eco-system and the fast-changing automotive sector.

At Free2Move, data science and analytics are at the very core of our products and decision-making. Our analytics team tackles a wide range of impactful topics—from influencing key business decisions and optimizing operations, to putting the algorithms that govern critical aspects of our products into production.

You will be joining our dedicated Pricing Analytics team, which takes charge of all topics related to pricing.

We deeply understand pricing dynamics and use this expertise to build and improve Machine Learning algorithms that define our pricing in real-time.

Your Next Missions As a Data Engineer in our team, you will own the full lifecycle of data products and act as a technical leader.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Data Scientists to bring state-of-the-art, real-time pricing algorithms to production for millions of users.

  • Taking full ownership of the data pipelines within the Pricing Analytics scope.

  • Architecting and building the right systems to solve highly complex or vaguely defined problems.

  • Engaging with cross-functional stakeholders to lead the design, development, optimization, and productionization of ML and ML-based solutions.

  • Managing the infrastructure on which our Pricing algorithm runs and taking responsibility for the performance of the pricing ML system.

  • Leading cross-team efforts to leverage and scale our ML infrastructure for model development, training, and deployment needs.

  • Writing well-crafted, well-tested, readable, and maintainable production-quality code.

Who You Are & What You Bring We believe in team success over individual achievement and foster a highly collaborative environment. To thrive in this role, you bring:

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Coding Expertise: Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, with a strong track record of writing clean, modular, optimized code for complex data transformations. (Note: Previous experience as a Data Scientist is a strong plus!)

  • Data Modeling: Significant hands-on experience modeling enterprise Data Warehouses using dbt (including Kimball methodology, dimensional modeling, star schemas, data testing, and data lineage).

  • Cloud & Big Data: Strong experience with the Databricks ecosystem (Delta Lake, PySpark, Unity Catalog, SQL Endpoints, Serverless compute) and AWS cloud infrastructure (S3, IAM, KMS, DataSync).

  • Orchestration & DevOps: Solid experience writing and orchestrating complex production DAGs using Apache Airflow (or MWAA), managing deployments with Docker/Kubernetes, and working with CI/CD pipelines (Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform).

  • Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise dashboards using Tableau, PowerBI, or Databricks SQL Dashboards.

  • Modern Workflows: A habit of actively leveraging AI tools (like Claude and Databricks AI features) to accelerate pipeline creation, automate dbt documentation, and write smart PR review guardrails.

  • Compliance & Security: A solid understanding of GDPR requirements, including how to enforce PII masking, access control policies, data retention, and auditing via Unity Catalog.

  • Mindset & Communication: An analytical mindset capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, bulletproof data marts and KPI metrics. You prefer simple, efficient, well-tested code over fragile architectures. You can also communicate complex technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders and domain teams (Pricing, Customer, Advanced Analytics).

  • Languages: Fluency in English (written and oral) is required to work effectively in our international context.


What we offer 🎁

Working at Free2move means becoming part of a tribe in which the culture of performance rhymes with a good atmosphere. It is also:

  • A start-up spirit supported by a large Group

  • The opportunity to revolutionize the uses of mobility with us!

  • A neat integration to start well

  • Lots of possibilities for development

  • Collaboration with multidisciplinary and international teams

  • International projects to perfect your background!

  • An access to our E-Learningplatform 📚 : for the development of languages and other skills...This list is not exhaustive...

Job type:
Permanent contract

Location : France, Spain or Italy

Package :

  • Annual gross salary package depending of your experience:+/- 50/60K€

jobs.title: Implementation Analyst - Grad Program 2027
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for new applicants to join our Graduate Program as an Implementation Analyst!
jobs.description:
We are looking for new applicants to join our Graduate Program as an Implementation Analyst! This position is set to start in July of 2027.

Our analysts are recruited from variety of universities and come from all major backgrounds. Following an in depth induction training program delivered by our subject matter experts, you will be assigned to a project where you can put your training into practice.

You will usually start out by working on a client project or internal investment team, and your first role will involve implementing or improving our software implementation for our clients. Supervised by more experienced consultants, you will find that the open culture means you also have easy access to senior managers and directors for discussion and guidance. With this support readily available, you can help our clients change the way they work from the very start of your career.

During a project we also need to modify business processes to ensure the client is working as effectively as possible, test that everything works, transfer all the data from the old system to Alfa Systems, and provide support through the go-live process and into the future. During your career, you will spend time working in a variety of roles in these areas. As you progress, you will develop particular abilities and interests and you can choose your training to support that. You might want to work towards being a Project Manager for instance, or a Technical Architect of our software; that’s up to you.

Key responsibilities may include:

  • Assist with and develop skills in one or more areas of software implementation, such as:

    • Undertaking testing and quality assurance of Alfa Systems

    • Issue investigation and recreation, raising issues with the Product Engineering Team / on project with sufficient detail so they can be progressed

    • Escalate high priority issues

    • Installing and configuring Alfa Systems

    • Environment management and product releases

    • Data migration development and execution

    • Simple business requirements and gap analysis

  • Sharing information and documenting knowledge

  • Learn about Alfa Systems and how our products are used by our customers

  • Build relevant technical skills such as SQL/Java and processes such as debugging

  • Undertake requirements gathering and development of new features in Alfa Systems

  • Continuous development of people, teamwork and communication skills including developing relationships with the customer project team

What we’ll do for you:

  • 33 days’ annual leave (incl. 9 public holidays/cultural days) and the possibility to buy up to 10 more days a year

  • Flexible work - hybrid or remote work with modern workspaces available

  • Health, Dental and Vision insurance with reimbursement of copays/coinsurance/deductibles for in-network medical costs

  • Voluntary Accident and Critical Illness Insurance

  • Health and Dependent Care FSA

  • Fully paid-for life, disability and travel insurances

  • Gym and Wellness Scheme through Wellhub with access to a range of studios, gyms and wellbeing apps

  • 401k plan - matching at 100% of the first 6% contributed (immediately vested)

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 crisis support

  • 3 paid volunteering days as well as 5 paid learning and development days

  • Fun social events throughout the year and annual Company Conferences

About Alfa

With over 500 employees worldwide, we’re a leading provider of software and services to the global auto and equipment finance industries. Alfa Systems, our technology platform, is at the heart of some of the world’s largest auto and equipment finance companies. Key to the business case for each implementation is Alfa Systems’ ability to consolidate multiple client systems onto a single platform. Alfa Systems supports both retail and corporate business for auto, equipment, wholesale and dealer finance on a multi-jurisdictional basis, including leases and loans, originations and servicing. Alfa Systems is an end-to-end solution with integrated workflow and automated processing using configurable business rules, with an extensive API allowing real-time integration to other systems. With over 30 current clients and 26 countries served, Alfa has been delivering successful projects for our customers since 1990, and is expanding rapidly throughout Europe, North America and beyond.

Our Culture

Our culture is vibrant, innovative and diverse, and we are proud of it. Ours is a close-knit community. Alfa employees are an eclectic mix and all are creative, dedicated and hardworking. We believe it is important to build close working relationships within our company, so we hold numerous team events and conferences that bring us together for socializing and team building. We all enjoy the work-life balance and the great culture, with plenty of social activities organized by the company.

For more information on our graduate program, check out our graduate page.

jobs.description:
About our team:

At Sage, our Journals Sales team partners with academic libraries and research institutions across North America to ensure broad access to high-quality scholarly content. We play a critical role in supporting the dissemination of research by helping customers improve the value of Sage's journal portfolio while navigating an evolving publishing landscape.

As part of this collaborative and customer-focused team, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Open Access, and Publishing to drive renewals, strengthen client relationships, and identify growth opportunities. You'll contribute to meaningful conversations around the future of scholarly communication, including Open Access publishing models and transformative agreements as appropriate, while helping libraries meet the needs of their researchers, faculty, and students.

Role Summary:

As a Journal Sales Partner, this individual supports the management of Sage’s Premier Active Renewals portfolio in North America, contributing to consistent year-over-year revenue uplift across annual journal package renewals. The role focuses on retaining accounts, upgrading customers to current journal package offerings, and helping to identify opportunities for growth. Working with guidance from senior colleagues while building toward greater independence, this position ensures responsive communication, operational efficiency, and reliable customer engagement.

Your New Role:

  • Support the full cycle of Premier Active Renewals in North America, working towards a maximum uplift year over year across journal package renewals.
  • Upgrade accounts to reflect the most current journal package list, ensuring alignment with product offerings and customer needs.
  • Respond to internal and external requests on the same business day, maintaining a high standard of responsiveness and reliability.
  • Provide clear status updates and summaries for management as needed to support visibility and decision-making.
  • Participate in Open Access conversations, helping customers understand OA frameworks and supporting the organization’s transition to new publishing models.
  • Assist with account activity involving Mary Ann Liebert titles as needed, collaborating cross-functionally to support revenue and relationship goals.
  • Contribute to workflow improvements, identifying efficiencies that help streamline operations and support team performance.
  • Maintain thorough and up-to-date documentation to track the status of each renewal effort throughout the year, supporting transparency and planning.
  • Keep the CRM system consistently up to date, accurately reflecting customer interactions, renewal status, and pipeline activity.
  • Adopt and apply new CRM features and enhancements as they are rolled out, contributing to team-wide protocols in sales technology.

Can you be our new Journals Sales Partner?

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in sales, customer renewals, or account management, ideally within scholarly publishing.
  • Exposure to journal renewals and an interest in finding opportunities for account upgrades and growth.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools, particularly Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics CRM; able to maintain accurate records and support sales goals.
  • Competency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word), with the ability to work with data sets and reporting tools.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines.
  • Ability to work with a degree of independence while contributing to a team-focused, goal-oriented environment.
  • Familiarity with Open Access publishing and trends in academic library purchasing preferred.

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with Sage covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. jobs.description:
Senior Buyer

Status: Exempt

Department: Purchasing/Supply Chain

Position Summary

The Senior Buyer serves a critical role to Plug Power by working to procure necessary parts and components in support of the manufacturing operation while also acting as a lead resource for the rest of the purchasing team. The Senior Buyer role must establish very strong and mutually beneficial relationships with suppliers and therefore requires dynamic interpersonal skills. A most successful Senior Buyer exhibits timely and accurate transactional work, exceptional cross-functional collaboration, hands-on communication skills, and untiring follow-up to ensure completion of critical tasks and projects. The ideal candidate is able to self-manage projects and company initiatives with limited direction required from management. This individual may be involved in negotiating short- and long-term agreements, incorporating strategic purchasing initiatives, developing and implementing procurement strategies. Additionally, the Senior Buyer will be looked to as a purchasing team lead and will service as an advisor and mentor to other purchasing staff.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform transactional duties including placing of purchase orders to procure material in support of manufacturing and other business functions
  • Build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships; communicate regularly to maintain an understanding of timelines and activities which impact supply chain
  • Act as a primary partner to the manufacturing operation by understanding build schedules and managing supply chain activities to increase efficiency and eliminate downtime
  • Take responsibility for accurate and on-time delivery of parts and components; follow-up on PO’s with suppliers and manage delivery date expectations as necessary with all relevant stakeholders
  • Understand material specifications and quality metrics affecting assigned parts and components; work collaboratively to resolve quality issues with suppliers
  • Develop strong relationships with suppliers and communicate regularly; manage date pull-ins and push-outs on an ongoing basis
  • Serve as a mentor and advisor to the purchasing team, guiding and directing activities of fellow Buyers as needed
  • Train new team members, acting as advisor and resource
  • Leverage positive working relationships with suppliers based upon mutual benefit; seek favorable terms and conditions which positively impact pricing, quality, payment terms, and others as applicable
  • Track supplier performance and provide regular feedback to relevant stakeholders; set clear expectations with suppliers and work to add/replace suppliers as needed for optimal business results
  • Collaborate with colleagues in the finance department to resolve supplier payment issues
  • Represent Plug Power in a professional manner at all times and in all interactions
  • Perform all other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Engineering, Business, or other applicable field of study and five (5) or more years of related work experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Experience within a technology manufacturing environment is highly preferred
  • Must be capable of working independently, in a fast-paced environment, with minimal supervision
  • Demonstrated analytical abilities with strong attention to detail
  • Superior communication skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office software including highly developed skills within Excel
  • Ability to manage projects and multi-task effectively
  • Ability to role model high standards of professionalism
  • Excellent follow-through
  • Must be driven and self-motivated
  • Must possess the highest ethical standards and a supreme commitment to quality Exempt employees are expected to work as many hours as is necessary to complete their job responsibilities. This may require they work more than eight hours a day and more than five days or 40 hours per week.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position.  Evidence Solutions, Inc.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Evidence Solutions, Inc. is a nationally recognized expert witness and litigation support firm providing consulting across a wide range of civil and criminal matters. Our team partners with attorneys, insurance carriers, municipalities, corporations, and government entities to deliver credible and defensible expert analysis. 
We provide our experts with full-service support including marketing/business development, case intake and client support, billing and collections, allowing experts to focus on what they love doing best — working with the evidence.  
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Firearms & Ballistics Expert Witness to join our team of forensic and litigation support professionals. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in firearms examination, ballistic analysis, shooting incident reconstruction, and the application of forensic science to firearms-related cases. This role is well suited for a Firearms Examiner, Ballistics Analyst, Forensic Scientist, Law Enforcement Firearms Specialist, or Military Weapons Expert who has investigated and analyzed shooting incidents and understands the standards and methodologies governing firearms evidence. 
This position provides an opportunity to apply firearms and ballistics expertise to legal matters involving shooting incidents, firearm functionality, trajectory analysis, and weapons-related forensic investigations. 

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:
  • Conduct forensic examinations of firearms, ammunition, and ballistic evidence, including bullets, cartridge cases, and gunshot residue. 
  • Analyze shooting incidents, including trajectory analysis, distance determination, and reconstruction of events based on physical evidence. 
  • Evaluate firearm functionality, safety mechanisms, and potential defects or malfunctions. 
  • Review case materials including scene evidence, autopsy reports, police reports, and forensic lab findings to assess firearm-related events. 
  • Review and validate evidence of handling procedures including chain of custody, laboratory analysis, and testing protocols. 
  • Assess use-of-force scenarios involving firearms, including officer-involved shootings, self-defense claims, and accidental discharges. 
  • Consult with legal teams to assess firearms evidence, identify inconsistencies, and support case strategy. 
  • Prepare detailed expert reports and professional opinions based on accepted firearms examination methodologies and forensic science principles. 
  • Provide expert witness testimony in depositions and trials, translating complex concepts and firearms & ballistics findings into clear and defensible opinions
  • Stay current on developments in firearms technology, ballistic analysis techniques, forensic standards, and legal precedents related to firearms cases. 
Qualifications:
  • 15+ years of professional experience in Firearms Examination, Ballistics Analysis, Law Enforcement or Military Firearms Specialist roles, Crime Lab Forensics, or related fields.
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Forensic Science, Criminal Justice, Ballistics, or a related field preferred. 
  • Extensive experience in firearms examination, ballistics analysis, or forensic firearms investigations. 
  • Deep understanding of firearms and forensic standards, including toolmark identification, trajectory analysis, gunshot residue testing, and evidence comparison techniques. 
  • Experience working with laboratory testing procedures, firearms databases (e.g., NIBIN), and forensic analysis tools. 
  • Strong knowledge of firearm safety standards and shooting incident reconstruction. 
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing firearms-related evidence and presenting findings in investigative or legal settings. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex forensic concepts to attorneys, juries, and non-technical audiences. 
  • Prior expert witness or courtroom testimony experience is preferred. 
  • Relevant certifications or training in firearms examination, forensic science, or ballistics analysis are strongly preferred.

Benefits

Compensation & Structure:
  • 1099 independent contractor arrangement 
  • WFH 
  • Competitive hourly expert witness compensation 
  • Flexible case-based workload 
Why Partner with ESI

About the Role

We are looking for annotators with computer vision or image labeling experience to perform 2D human pose (keypoint) annotation on thermal images within the client's Label Studio environment. You will identify people in each image and place a defined set of anatomical keypoints per person, including in cases of partial occlusion or ambiguous body positioning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review each assigned thermal image and identify the number of people present.

  • Create a separate annotation for each individual identified in the image.

  • Position each keypoint as close as possible to the true center of the corresponding body part.

  • Infer and place the expected anatomical position for keypoints that are obstructed or occluded.

  • Indicate a confidence flag when keypoint placement is uncertain due to difficult body positioning or orientation.

  • Submit completed annotations directly within the client's Label Studio instance.

  • Participate in QA/rework cycles, revising annotations as needed based on reviewer feedback.

Requirements

Required:

  • Prior experience with computer vision annotation, image labeling, or similar data annotation work.

  • Solid understanding of human anatomy sufficient to accurately place and infer keypoints, even when partially visible.

  • Sharp attention to detail and spatial reasoning, able to distinguish subtle differences in body positioning and orientation.

  • Comfort working with thermal/infrared imagery (lower contrast, less visual clarity than standard RGB images).

  • Ability to follow detailed annotation guidelines precisely and apply them consistently across large volumes of images.

  • Good judgment for ambiguous cases (occlusion, unusual poses, overlapping people) and appropriate flagging of uncertainty rather than guessing silently.

  • Familiarity with Label Studio, or willingness to quickly learn the platform.

  • Reliable, self-directed work habits.

  • Experience with human pose estimation or keypoint annotation datasets (e.g., COCO keypoints format).

  3. If a hot new open-source AI model gets released tomorrow and you want to test it out locally on your own laptop or machine (not just using a web browser), how would you set that up? What specific software, tools, or frameworks would you use to get it running?

Your home office or our Waltham, MA HQ or hybrid

Qualifications

Hard Requirements

  • Solid grasp of agent architectures, prompt engineering, and MCP or tool-use patterns
  • Hands-on experience with local/open-source LLMs: you've run them, tuned them, deployed them
  • Comfortable working in Linux environments and debugging at the command line
  • Strong communicator: you can explain what's broken and why to both engineers and non-engineers
  • This is not a role for someone who has tried out some youtube tutorial videos on their own. You need to have some real experience implementing this.

Helpful Background

  • 2+ years Python development — real shipped and used code
  • Experience with RAG pipelines or vector databases
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and integration patterns
  • Docker comfort
  • Background in storage systems or HPC environments (this helps more than you think)

Working Style

  • You can context-switch between deep development work and supporting a customer mid-debug
  • You're comfortable being the person who figures things out when there's no playbook yet

About Starfish Storage

Starfish Storage is an established company that maintains a startup culture mindset. We cater to a diverse client base, serving industries such as life sciences, artificial intelligence, and research computing. Our technology is critical to modern organizations, helping customers organize, manage, and move the tens of billions of files central to their operations.

Most AI work right now is happening in the cloud, with managed APIs, and relatively clean data. Some of our customers can't do that: they're operating in classified or regulated environments with filesystem metadata spanning billions of files. The AI problems here are genuinely hard, the deployments are genuinely constrained, and the work actually matters to science and research.

If you want AI work that's genuinely constrained, genuinely consequential, and can't phone home to OpenAI — this is it.

Job Overview

Starfish manages petabytes of unstructured data for national labs, research institutions, fintech, and pharma, the kind of data that doesn't fit neatly into databases or cloud buckets. We're building an AI-native layer on top of that: MCP servers, agentic workflows, local LLM deployments, and tools that let researchers and engineers actually talk to their storage infrastructure. We're tackling hard questions too: should an agent be permitted to move 2PB of data autonomously? How do you govern that?

In this role, you'll build and ship MCP servers, deploy and tune local LLMs, write custom agents for real customers with real petabyte-scale problems, and get them running in environments where "just use the API" isn't an option. You'll also support customers when things don't work: which means you need to actually understand what you've built.

  • Build and expand MCP servers that expose Starfish's data management capabilities to LLM-powered workflows
  • Develop intelligent agents that can reason over storage metadata at scale — including local LLM deployment and configuration using vLLM, Ollama, or similar
  • Create workflow automation and chat-based interfaces for querying and acting on Starfish data
  • Build proof-of-concept implementations and turn them into production-grade features

Customer-Facing Technical Work

  • Support customers through installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of AI features and integrations
  • Get on calls with technical teams, understand their use cases, and translate requirements into working agents
  • Document what you learn so the next person doesn't have to figure it out from scratch

jobs.excerpt: Develer è un’azienda del gruppo Comelz, che svolge attività di progettazione, produzione elettronica e sviluppo software per il mondo industriale.
jobs.description:
Develer è un’azienda del gruppo Comelz, che svolge attività di progettazione, produzione elettronica e sviluppo software per il mondo industriale.

Cerchiamo nuovi collaboratori e collaboratrici da inserire nei nostri team di sviluppo software, appartenenti alle categorie protette, in tre aree:

  • Embedded Linux e firmware
  • Sviluppo desktop e embedded
  • Sviluppo web full stack

Su cosa lavoriamo?

I progetti tipici su cui lavoriamo riguardano:

Embedded Linux e firmware

  • Applicazioni ferroviarie, anche in sicurezza
  • Controllo di processi di automazione industriale.
  • Macchine a controllo numerico, per controllo motori e bus di campo industriali.
  • Internet of Things (con trasmissioni dati in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GSM).
  • Interfacce utente per dispositivi embedded con display touch.

Sviluppo desktop e embedded

  • Controllo di macchine industriali.
  • Realizzazione di interfacce utente per dispositivi embedded con display touch.
  • Software per il disegno tecnico 2D e 3D per il settore calzaturiero.

Sviluppo web full stack

  • Analisi e reportistica di dati acquisiti da macchine industriali.
  • Raccolta e visualizzazione di metriche collezionate da applicazioni web.
  • Portali per la configurazione e gestione remota di macchine industriali.

A seconda del tipo di progetto, la parte principale del lavoro consisterà in:

Embedded Linux e firmware

  • Sviluppare a basso livello su un sistema Linux embedded: realizzazione di BSP, kernel driver, demoni user space.
  • Sviluppare in C su bare metal / microcontrollori: driver e uso di RTOS.
  • Aiutare il team di progettisti elettronici nel test e debug delle schede progettate.

Sviluppo desktop e embedded

  • Realizzare applicazioni multipiattaforma (desktop e tablet), utilizzando le librerie Qt
  • Creare interfacce utente, su sistemi desktop o embedded, e costruire il collegamento verso la logica di backend
  • Scrivere algoritmi e logiche di backend al servizio delle applicazioni

Sviluppo web full stack

  • Realizzare interfacce di controllo per dispositivi industriali accessibili da browser.
  • Sviluppare API HTTP per l'interoperabilità di applicazioni web e mobile.
  • Creare applicazioni web per per il monitoraggio di dispositivi e la reportistica di dati in tempo reale.
  • Contribuire allo sviluppo di applicazioni web distribuite, realizzate con microservizi, che fanno uso di Amazon AWS.

Per Embedded Linux e firmware, ti capiterà di dover accedere agli schemi elettrici delle schede, realizzati con Altium Designer. A volte, sarà necessario creare degli strumenti software per semplificare lo sviluppo o per realizzare piccoli applicativi di test: in questi casi, i linguaggi e le tecnologie che preferiamo usare sono C++, Python, Bash, Go, Qt / QML.

Per lo sviluppo software desktop ed embedded è un requisito la conoscenza di almeno uno tra i linguaggi C, C++, Python e Go.

Per lo sviluppo software web full stack ti chiediamo la conoscenza delle principali tecnologie legate allo sviluppo software moderno per il web: in particolare, per la parte di frontend, angular.js o react.js. Per la parte di backend, lavoriamo con Python o Go, ma, se utilizzi altri linguaggi, non ti preoccupare, per noi non costituisce un problema.

Siamo alla ricerca di persone appassionate, curiose, intraprendenti e flessibili che vogliano contribuire alla crescita dei progetti attraverso la realizzazione di sistemi tecnologicamente avanzati e dalle elevate prestazioni e affidabilità.

Cerchiamo persone capaci di identificare le soluzioni e gli strumenti più adatti, con l’obiettivo di aumentare il valore e la qualità dei prodotti che offriamo.

Si richiede l'appartenenza alle Categorie Protette L. 68/99 (anche art. 18)

Come lavoriamo?

  • I progetti sono affidati a team piccoli (2-5 persone in media), con un project manager, che svolge anche il ruolo di account manager verso il cliente, e un tech leader per la direzione tecnica e l’organizzazione del lavoro: solitamente ogni team segue un progetto alla volta.
  • Il nostro modo di lavorare si ispira ai principi dell’Agile Manifesto. Non seguiamo un metodo in particolare, lasciamo ai team la libertà di organizzarsi utilizzando le tecniche che ritengono più efficaci. Facciamo retrospettive e decidiamo assieme al cliente quali cambiamenti possiamo introdurre ad ogni iterazione per migliorare la qualità di ciò che rilasciamo.
  • Utilizziamo Slack per comunicare con il team, con gli altri colleghi e i clienti, GSuite per gli strumenti di collaborazione, Trello come Kanban Board, lavagne, post-it e tutto ciò che serve per rendere la comunicazione continua, agevole e diretta.
  • L’ambiente di lavoro è un grande open space silenzioso, inaugurato di recente. I membri di ciascun team occupano un’isola, per essere vicini e poter comunicare facilmente. Ci sono anche divanetti, aree riservate e sale riunioni per poter stare più concentrati quando si lavora in ufficio.
  • Usiamo principalmente workstation Linux o macOS per lavorare. Ogni postazione ha due monitor, sedia ergonomica comoda ed è possibile avere una scrivania con il piano rialzabile. Ogni develeriano può anche richiedere altri accessori per rendere più confortevole il posto di lavoro.

Benefici

  • Siamo convinti che il tempo speso in ufficio non sia direttamente proporzionale alla produttività e per questo l’orario di lavoro è flessibile. Decidi tu, insieme al tuo team, gli orari di lavoro che più si adattano alla tua vita e il tuo lavoro potrà essere svolto completamente da remoto!

  • Se hai necessità di periodi di pausa, la banca ore ti permette di gestire il tempo con maggiore libertà: puoi uscire prima e rimanere qualche ora in più un altro giorno

  • Ogni dipendente ha a disposizione un budget annuale da utilizzare per la propria formazione professionale: Develer organizza diverse attività e potrai partecipare alle conferenze, corsi, eventi, workshop che più ti interessano. Ti verrà riconosciuto un rimborso per le spese e il tempo necessario per partecipare

  • Fare una buona pausa e rilassarsi sono importanti per lavorare bene: abbiamo una grande area relax con poltrone, proiettore, impianto audio, calcio balilla, ping pong e strumenti musicali. In aggiunta, la zona pranzo e la cucina sono forniti di frutta, snack e bevande fredde e calde. Quando arriva l’estate, è disponibile uno spazio verde, attrezzato con il barbecue

  • Le aree e le attrezzature aziendali sono utilizzabili anche per scopi extra-lavorativi e personali: c’è chi usa i monitor 80” delle sale riunioni per tornei playstation la sera

  • Ci troviamo vicino ad un bar della zona rinomato per la qualità del cibo e abbiamo una convenzione per pranzare a prezzo molto conveniente

  • Develer non è solo lavoro: sono organizzati periodicamente eventi e feste aziendali, visite guidate, gite e attività di team building

Alcuni dei punti sopra elencati al momento non sono praticabili causa covid.
Nonostante tutto, non ci siamo scoraggiati e abbiamo pensato ulteriori benefit che possano rendere piacevole la vita lavorativa dei develeriani.
Dai uno sguardo a questo link per vedere i benefit, ad integrazione di quelli già esistenti, pensati per questo momento di distanza sociale.

Come funziona il processo di selezione?

Dal momento in cui riceviamo la candidatura, impieghiamo circa due settimane per fare una prima valutazione. In questa fase, valutiamo le tue esperienze. Se sono in linea con il profilo che cerchiamo, fissiamo un primo colloquio per conoscerci.

Durante questo colloquio, il nostro obiettivo è quello di conoscerci reciprocamente e darti tutte le informazioni possibili in modo da capire insieme se andare avanti o fermarci qui.

Se andremo avanti si passerà ai colloqui tecnici, svolti da persone che fanno il tuo stesso lavoro o con le quali dovrai interagire più spesso.

È probabile che ti venga chiesto di rispondere ad alcune domande e risolvere alcuni problemi. Potremmo svolgere assieme a te degli esercizi di programmazione o di progettazione: ricordati che il nostro obiettivo non è quello di farti un esame, ma di capire a quale punto del tuo percorso professionale sei arrivato e decidere insieme se il prossimo passo è nella nostra stessa direzione o quale può essere il percorso di formazione nei primi mesi in Develer.

Entro qualche settimana dal termine delle interviste, ti comunicheremo com’è andata e potremmo arrivare a farti un’offerta.

Tieni presente che tutti i colloqui verranno fatti da remoto. Per questa ragione, ti chiediamo di avere a disposizione una buona connessione ad Internet, una videocamera e delle buone cuffie con microfono, sarà necessario l’uso del video e probabilmente la condivisione dello schermo. Più sotto, trovi qualche consiglio per prepararti. Inoltre, ti chiederemo di avere sul tuo computer l’ambiente di sviluppo che utilizzi normalmente, configurato e pronto all’uso: se sarà necessario installare altro software, te lo faremo sapere con un buon anticipo. A questo proposito, puoi trovare una guida con qualche consiglio utile a questo indirizzo:

Conosciamoci meglio!

Ti interessa conoscerci meglio prima di inviarci la candidatura? Puoi partecipare ad uno degli eventi che organizziamo o alle conferenze che sponsorizziamo. Trovi tutte le informazioni a questi indirizzi

Conferenze e techLabs -

L’annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi dell’articolo 1 L. 903/77.

  • site jurídico nº1 do mundo em número de acessos
  • mais de 20 milhões de usuários por mês
  • mais de 7 bilhões de documentos jurídicos de interesse público
  • mais de 80% dos advogados brasileiros cadastrados
  • 670 pessoas jusbrasileiras, quase metade em tecnologia e produto
  • presença em mais de 125 cidades no Brasil e fora
  • modelo remoto: liberdade de escolher onde viver, sem perder a vaga certa
Sobre o desafio

A pessoa Security Partner (AppSec) será responsável por garantir que os produtos B2B do Jusbrasil sejam construídos com uma base sólida de segurança — atuando de forma integrada e embarcada dentro do time de Jus Soluções. O papel é hands-on e exige uma mentalidade de construtor: mais do que revisar o que já foi feito, esperamos alguém que participe desde o início do ciclo de desenvolvimento, antecipe riscos e implemente soluções reais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto focal de segurança dentro do Jus Soluções, participando de plannings, refinements e RFCs com os times de engenharia e produto.
  • Liderar a implementação de autenticação robusta e Single Sign-On (SSO), incluindo separação de domínio e integração com provedores de identidade externos.
  • Garantir que aplicações, APIs e integrações sejam desenvolvidas com princípios de Secure by Design — desde o design até o delivery.
  • Realizar threat modeling recorrente em produtos e fluxos críticos, identificando e priorizando riscos com base em impacto de negócio.
  • Conduzir security reviews contínuos — de código, arquitetura e integrações externas — em conjunto com os times de engenharia.
  • Construir e manter práticas de AppSec: secure coding guidelines, checklists de revisão e documentação de decisões técnicas de segurança.
  • Traduzir riscos técnicos em impacto de negócio para stakeholders de produto, liderança e clientes — incluindo relatórios e recomendações acionáveis.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento de software
  • Conhecimento prático em Application Security: OWASP Top 10, API Security, autenticação (OAuth 2.0, JWT, SSO, OIDC) e proteção de dados.
  • Experiência com cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e arquitetura moderna: microserviços, APIs REST/gRPC e integrações externas.
  • Capacidade de influenciar times sem autoridade direta — atuando como parceiro técnico.
  • Fluência em IA: Experiência utilizando ferramentas de IA Generativa como parte do fluxo de trabalho
  • Perfil proativo e resolutivo, com autonomia para construir soluções do zero e conforto com ambiguidade.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com LGPD e requisitos de proteção de dados aplicados a produtos digitais
  • Familiaridade com infraestrutura segura e desenvolvimento de projetos com soluções open source.
